speaker: Donald Trump
text: When I see the crumbling roads and bridges, or the dilapidated airports, or the factories moving overseas to Mexico, or to other countries, I know these problems can all be fixed, but not by Hillary Clinton – only by me.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The fact is, we can come back bigger and better and stronger than ever before --Jobs, jobs, jobs!

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Everywhere I look, I see the possibilities of what our country could be.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But we can’t solve any of these problems by relying on the politicians who created them.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will never be able to fix a rigged system by counting on the same people who rigged it in the first place.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The insiders wrote the rules of the game to keep themselves in power and in the money.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That’s why we’re asking Bernie Sanders’ voters to join our movement: so together we can fix the system for ALL Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Importantly, this includes fixing all of our many disastrous trade deals.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Because it’s not just the political system that’s rigged.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s the whole economy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s rigged by big donors who want to keep down wages.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s rigged by big businesses who want to leave our country, fire our workers, and sell their products back into the U.S. with absolutely no consequences for them.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s rigged by bureaucrats who are trapping kids in failing schools.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s rigged against you, the American people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton who, as most people know, is a world class liar – just look at her pathetic email and server statements, or her phony landing in Bosnia where she said she was under attack but the attack turned out to be young girls handing her flowers, a total self-serving lie.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Brian Williams’ career was destroyed for saying far less.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Yesterday, she even tried to attack me and my many businesses.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But here is the bottom line: I started off in Brooklyn New York, not so long ago, with a small loan and built a business worth over 10 billion dollars.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have always had a talent for building businesses and, importantly, creating jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That is a talent our country desperately needs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am running for President to end the unfairness and to put you, the American worker, first.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to put America First, and we are going to Make America Great again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This election will decide whether we are ruled by the people, or by the politicians.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here is my promise to the American voter: If I am elected President, I will end the special interest monopoly in Washington, D.C.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The other candidate in this race has spent her entire life making money for special interests – and taking money from special interests.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton has perfected the politics of personal profit and theft.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She ran the State Department like her own personal hedge fund – doing favors for oppressive regimes, and many others, in exchange for cash.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Then, when she left, she made $21.6 million giving speeches to Wall Street banks and other special interests – in less than 2 years – secret speeches that she does not want to reveal to the public.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Together, she and Bill made $153 million giving speeches to lobbyists, CEOs, and foreign governments in the years since 2001.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They totally own her, and that will never change.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The choice in this election is a choice between taking our government back from the special interests, or surrendering our last scrap of independence to their total and complete control.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Those are the stakes.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton wants to be President.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But she doesn't have the temperament, or, as Bernie Sanders' said, the judgement, to be president.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She believes she is entitled to the office.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Her campaign slogan is “I’m with her.” You know what my response to that is?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I’m with you: the American people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She thinks it’s all about her.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I know it’s all about you – I know it’s all about making America Great Again for All Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our country lost its way when we stopped putting the American people first.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We got here because we switched from a policy of Americanism – focusing on what’s good for America’s middle class – to a policy of globalism, focusing on how to make money for large corporations who can move their wealth and workers to foreign countries all to the detriment of the American worker and the American economy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We reward companies for offshoring, and we punish companies for doing business in America and keeping our workers employed.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is not a rising tide that lifts all boats.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is a wave of globalization that wipes out our middle class and our jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We need to reform our economic system so that, once again, we can all succeed together, and America can become rich again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That’s what we mean by America First.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our country will be better off when we start making our own products again, bringing our once great manufacturing capabilities back to our shores.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our Founders understood this.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: One of the first major bills signed by George Washington called for “the encouragement and protection of manufacturing” in America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our first Republican President, Abraham Lincoln, warned us by saying: “The abandonment of the protective policy by the American government will produce want and ruin among our people.” I have visited the cities and towns across America and seen the devastation caused by the trade policies of Bill and Hillary Clinton.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton supported Bill Clinton’s disastrous NAFTA, just like she supported China’s entrance into the World Trade Organization.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We’ve lost nearly one-third of our manufacturing jobs since these two Hillary-backed agreements were signed.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our trade deficit with China soared 40% during Hillary Clinton’s time as Secretary of State -- a disgraceful performance for which she should not be congratulated, but rather scorned.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Then she let China steal hundreds of billions of dollars in our intellectual property – a crime which is continuing to this day.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton gave China millions of our best jobs, and effectively let China completely rebuild itself.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In return, Hillary Clinton got rich!

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The book Clinton Cash, by Peter Schweitzer, documents how Bill and Hillary used the State Department to enrich their family at America’s expense.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She gets rich making you poor.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here is a quote from the book: “At the center of US policy toward China was Hillary Clinton…at this critical time for US-china relations, Bill Clinton gave a number of speeches that were underwritten by the Chinese government and its supporters.” These funds were paid to the Clinton bank account while Hillary was negotiating with China on behalf of the United States.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She sold out our workers, and our country, for Beijing.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton has also been the biggest promoter of the Trans-Pacific Partnership, which will ship millions more of our jobs overseas – and give up Congressional power to an international foreign commission.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Now, because I have pointed out why it would be such a disastrous deal, she is pretending that she is against it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She has even deleted this record of total support from her book – deletion is something she is very good at -- (at least 30,000 emails are missing.) But this latest Clinton cover-up doesn’t change anything: if she is elected president, she will adopt the Trans-Pacific Partnership, and we will lose millions of jobs and our economic independence for good.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She will do this, just as she has betrayed the American worker on trade at every single stage of her career – and it will be even worse than the Clintons’ NAFTA deal.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I want trade deals, but they have to be great for the United States and our workers.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We don't make great deals anymore, but we will once I become president.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s not just our economy that’s been corrupted, but our foreign policy too.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Hillary Clinton foreign policy has cost America thousands of lives and trillions of dollars – and unleashed ISIS across the world.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: No Secretary of State has been more wrong, more often, and in more places than Hillary Clinton.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Her decisions spread death, destruction and terrorism everywhere she touched.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Among the victims is our late Ambassador, Chris Stevens.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: He was left helpless to die as Hillary Clinton soundly slept in her bed -- that's right, when the phone rang at 3 o'clock in the morning, she was sleeping.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Ambassador Stevens and his staff in Libya made hundreds of requests for security.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton’s State Department refused them all.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She started the war that put him in Libya, denied him the security he asked for, then left him there to die.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To cover her tracks, Hillary lied about a video being the cause of his death.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here is what one of the victim’s mothers had to say: “I want the whole world to know it: she lied to my face, and you don’t want this person to be president.” In 2009, before Hillary Clinton was sworn in, it was a different world.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Iraq was seeing a reduction in violence.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Syria was under control.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Iran was being choked by sanctions.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Egypt was governed by a friendly regime that honored its peace treaty with Israel.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: ISIS wasn’t even on the map.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Fast forward to 2013: In just four years, Secretary Clinton managed to almost single-handedly destabilize the entire Middle East.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Her invasion of Libya handed the country over to the ISIS barbarians.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Thanks to Hillary Clinton, Iran is now the dominant Islamic power in the Middle East, and on the road to nuclear weapons.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton’s support for violent regime change in Syria has thrown the country into one of the bloodiest civil wars anyone has ever seen – while giving ISIS a launching pad for terrorism against the West.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She helped force out a friendly regime in Egypt and replace it with the radical Muslim Brotherhood.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Egyptian military has retaken control, but Clinton has opened the Pandora’s box of radical Islam.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Then, there was the disastrous strategy of announcing our departure date from Iraq, handing large parts of the country over to ISIS killers.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: ISIS threatens us today because of the decisions Hillary Clinton has made.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: ISIS also threatens peaceful Muslims across the Middle East, and peaceful Muslims across the world, who have been terribly victimized by horrible brutality – and who only want to raise their kids in peace and safety.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In short, Hillary Clinton’s tryout for the presidency has produced one deadly foreign policy disaster after another.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It all started with her bad judgment in supporting the War in Iraq in the first place.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Though I was not in government service, I was among the earliest to criticize the rush to war, and yes, even before the war ever started.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But Hillary Clinton learned nothing from Iraq, because when she got into power, she couldn’t wait to rush us off to war in Libya.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She lacks the temperament, the judgment and the competence to lead.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In the words of a Secret Service agent posted outside the Oval Office: “She simply lacks the integrity and temperament to serve in the office…from the bottom of my soul, I know this to be true…Her leadership style – volcanic, impulsive…disdainful of the rules set for everyone else – hasn’t changed a bit.” Perhaps the most terrifying thing about Hillary Clinton’s foreign policy is that she refuses to acknowledge the threat posed by Radical Islam.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In fact, Hillary Clinton supports a radical 550% increase in Syrian refugees coming into the United States, and that's an increase over President Obama's already very high number.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Under her plan, we would admit hundreds of thousands of refugees from the most dangerous countries on Earth – with no way to screen who they are or what they believe.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Already, hundreds of recent immigrants and their children have been convicted of terrorist activity inside the U.S.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The father of the Orlando shooter was a Taliban supporter from Afghanistan, one of the most repressive anti-gay and anti-women regimes on Earth.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I only want to admit people who share our values and love our people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton wants to bring in people who believe women should be enslaved and gays put to death.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Maybe her motivation lies among the more than 1,000 foreign donations Hillary failed to disclose while at the State Department.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton may be the most corrupt person ever to seek the presidency.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here is some more of what we learned from the book, Clinton Cash: A foreign telecom giant faced possible State Department sanctions for providing technology to Iran, and other oppressive regimes.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: So what did this company do?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: For the first time ever, they decided to pay Bill Clinton $750,000 for a single speech.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Clintons got their cash, the telecom company escaped sanctions.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton’s State Department approved the transfer of 20% of America’s uranium holdings to Russia, while 9 investors in the deal funneled $145 million to the Clinton Foundation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton appointed a top donor to a national security board with top secret access – even though he had no national security credentials.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton accepted $58,000 in jewelry from the government of Brunei when she was Secretary of State – plus millions more for her foundation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Sultan of Brunei has pushed oppressive Sharia law, including the punishment of death by stoning for being gay.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The government of Brunei also stands to be one of the biggest beneficiaries of Hillary’s Trans-Pacific Partnership, which she would absolutely approve if given the chance.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton took up to $25 million from Saudi Arabia, where being gay is also punishable by death.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary took millions from Kuwait, Qatar, Oman and many other countries that horribly abuse women and LGBT citizens.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To cover-up her corrupt dealings, Hillary Clinton illegally stashed her State Department emails on a private server.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Her server was easily hacked by foreign governments – perhaps even by her financial backers in Communist China – putting all of America in danger.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Then there are the 33,000 emails she deleted.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: While we may not know what is in those deleted emails, our enemies probably do.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: So they probably now have a blackmail file over someone who wants to be President of the United States.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This fact alone disqualifies her from the Presidency.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We can’t hand over our government to someone whose deepest, darkest secrets may be in the hands of our enemies.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: National security is also immigration security – and Hillary wants neither.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton has put forward the most radical immigration platform in the history of the United States.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She has pledged to grant mass amnesty and in her first 100 days, end virtually all immigration enforcement, and thus create totally open borders in the United States The first victims of her radical policies will be poor African-American and Hispanic workers who need jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They are the ones she will hurt the most.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Let me share with you a letter our campaign received from Mary Ann Mendoza.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She lost her amazing son, Police Sergeant Brandon Mendoza, after he was killed by an illegal immigrant because of the open borders policies supported by Hillary Clinton.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Sadly, the Mendoza family is just one of thousands who have suffered the same fate.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here is an excerpt from Mrs. Mendoza’s letter: “Hillary Clinton, who already has the blood of so many on her hands, is now announcing that she is willing to put each and every one of our lives in harms’ way – an open door policy to criminals and terrorists to enter our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary is not concerned about you or I, she is only concerned about the power the presidency would bring to her.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She needs to go to prison to pay for the crimes she has already committed against this country.” Hillary also wants to spend hundreds of billions to resettle Middle Eastern refugees in the United States, on top of the current record level of immigration.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: For the amount of money Hillary Clinton would like to spend on refugees, we could rebuild every inner city in America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary’s Wall Street immigration agenda will keep immigrant communities poor, and unemployed Americans out of work.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She can’t claim to care about African-American and Hispanic workers when she wants to bring in millions of new low-wage workers to compete against them.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here are a few things a Trump Administration will do for America in the first 100 days: Appoint judges who will uphold the Constitution.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton’s radical judges will virtually abolish the 2nd amendment.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Change immigration rules to give unemployed Americans an opportunity to fill good-paying jobs Stand up to countries that cheat on trade, of which there are many Cancel rules and regulations that send jobs overseas Lift restrictions on energy production Repeal and replace job-killing Obamacare -- it is a disaster.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Pass massive tax reform to create millions of new jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Impose tough new ethics rules to restore dignity to the Office of Secretary of State.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: There is one common theme in all of these reforms.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s going to be America First.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is why the stakes in November are so great.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On election day, the politicians stand trial before the people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The voters are the jury.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Their ballots are the verdict.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We don’t need or want another Clinton or Obama.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Come November, the American people will have a chance to issue a verdict on the politicians that have sacrificed their security, betrayed their prosperity, and sold out their country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They will have a chance to vote for a new agenda with big dreams, bold ideas and enormous possibilities for the American people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton’s message is old and tired.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Her message is that things can’t change.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My message is that things have to change – and this is our one chance do it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is our last chance to do it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Americans are the people that tamed the West, that dug out the Panama Canal, that sent satellites across the solar system, that built the great dams, and so much more.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Then we started thinking small.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We stopped believing in what America could do, and became reliant on other countries, other people, and other institutions.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We lost our sense of purpose, and daring.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But that’s not who we are.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Come this November, we can bring America back – bigger and better, and stronger than ever.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will build the greatest infrastructure on the planet earth – the roads and railways and airports of tomorrow.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our military will have the best technology and finest equipment – we will bring it back all the way.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Massive new factories will come roaring into our country – breathing life and hope into our communities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Inner cities, which have been horribly abused by Hillary Clinton and the Democrat Party, will finally be rebuilt.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Construction is what I know -- nobody knows it better.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The real wages for our workers have not been raised for 18 years -- but these wages will start going up, along with the new jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary’s massive taxation, regulation and open borders will destroy jobs and drive down wages for everyone.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Yet, we've also seen increasing threats against our police and a substantial rise in the number of officers killed in the line of duty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: America's police and law enforcement personnel are what separates civilization from total chaos – and the destruction of our country as we know it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We must remember, the police are needed the most where crime is the highest.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Politicians and activists who seek to remove police or policing from a community are hurting the poorest and most vulnerable Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is time for the hostility against our police, and against all members of law enforcement, to end – and to end right now.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We went through an ugly chapter in our history, during Vietnam, when our troops became the victims of harassment and political agendas.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: For too many police today, that is their daily reality.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: At the same time, the tragic deaths in Louisiana and Minnesota make clear the work that must be done to ensure every American feels that their safety is protected.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We were all disturbed by the images we saw.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We must discuss, as well, the ongoing catastrophe of crime in our inner cities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: According to the Chicago Tribune, there has already been more than 2,000 shooting victims in Chicago this year alone.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This epidemic of violence destroys lives, destroys communities, and destroys opportunity for young Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Violent crime has increased in cities across America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The New York Times described a startling rise in murders, in our major cities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Brutal drug cartels are spreading their reach into Virginia and Maryland.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Too many Americans are trapped in fear, violence and poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our inner cities have been left behind, and I am going to fight to make sure every citizen of this country has a safe home, safe school and safe community.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We must maintain law and order at the highest level or we will cease to have a country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am the law and order candidate.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton, on the other hand, is weak, ineffective, pandering, and, as proven by her recent email scandal, which was an embarrassment not only to her, but to the nation as a whole, she is either a liar or grossly incompetent.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Personally, I think she is both.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Not only am I the law and order candidate, but I am also the candidate of compassion.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But you can't have true compassion without providing safety for the citizens of the United States.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every kid in America should be able to securely walk the streets in their own neighborhood.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Everyone will be protected equally and treated justly, without prejudice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will be tough, we will be smart, we will be fair – and we will protect all Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Without safety, we have nothing!

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is the job of the next President to Make America Safe Again — For Everyone.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That promise of protection must include taking care of every last Veteran, which was going to be the sole topic of today's speech prior to the attack in Dallas.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The men and women who have served in our armed forces represent the very best of America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Now is the time to follow their example of unity, public service and selfless devotion to our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We made a promise to these heroes.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: You defend America, and America will defend you.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But that promise has been broken by our politicians, like so many other promises our country has made – not only to its veterans, but to its citizens as a whole.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: President Obama has allowed our Veterans Affairs health care system to deny help and support to those who deserve it most.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton recently said of the VA scandal that it's not been as widespread as it has been made out to be.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She actually thinks that the Veterans Health Administration is well run – that's because she has been part of the rigged system.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Perhaps it is easy for politicians to lose touch with reality when they are being paid millions of dollars to read speeches to Wall Street executives – instead of spending time with real people in real pain.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The disconnect in America is deep.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: There are two Americas: the ruling class, and the groups it favors, and then everyone else.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The VA scandals that have occurred on this Administration's watch are widespread and inexcusable.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: An internal memo from a senior VA official describes lawlessness and chaos, at the Veterans Health Administration, including the payments of $6 billion a year in violation of federal contracting rules.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The memo also says they waste millions of dollars by paying excessive prices due to breaches of federal laws and warns that these unlawful acts may potentially result in serious harm or death to America's Veterans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Even the White House's own Deputy Chief of Staff described significant and chronic systemic failures, in Veterans Affairs, including a corrosive culture that has led to personnel problems across the Department, with poor management, and a history of retaliation toward employees raising issues.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: He said there is a lack of accountability across all grade levels.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here are just a few examples: --Forty veterans died waiting for care in Phoenix.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Forty different VA facilities nationwide were found to be manipulating and falsifying wait times.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: A VA employee who was involved in an armed robbery was kept on staff, as was a convicted sex offender.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The VA spent $8 million on solar panels for a facility knowing they would likely need to be torn down.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The St. Cloud, Minnessotta VA built a $2.3 million wind turbine in April 2011 that hasn't supplied power since 2012.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Can you imagine the waste and corruption we'll find when we begin a full investigation in January of 2017?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Most of those responsible have still not been held to account.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Fixing this corruption will be one of my highest priorities – and it will happen.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It will be fixed.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That begins with a simple promise: every Veteran will get timely access to top-quality care Veterans should be guaranteed the right to choose their doctor and clinics, whether at a VA facility or at a private medical center.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We must extend this right to all Veterans– not just those who can't get an appointment in 30 days, or who live more than 40 miles from a VA hospital, which is the current policy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This promise includes guaranteed access to the best available healthcare services for our female Veterans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We must also do more to help our Veterans find jobs Every year, large corporations bring in many thousands of low-wage workers from overseas, and across the border, to fill jobs that could easily be filled by our Veterans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Veterans should come first in the country they fought to protect, and under a Trump Administration they will -- America First, Veterans First.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Veterans' health care must also include the best mental health care.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: A shocking 20 Veterans are committing suicide each day, especially our older Veterans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is a national tragedy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The evidence shows that if Veterans are in the system, receiving care, they are much less likely to take their own lives than Veterans outside the system.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That is why we must increase the number of mental health care professionals inside the VA – while ensuring that Veterans can access private mental health care as well.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: America must take action to improve mental health services for the country at large.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This includes expanding the number of facilities, integrating primary care and mental care professionals, reforming confinement rules, and making it easier for family members who see warning signs to get their loved ones the care they need – especially in emergencies.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: One of the most important reforms we can make is accountability Right now, when VA employees fail our Veterans, you can't discipline them.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That's because of outdated civil service rules in need of reform.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In fact, employees are given bonuses after making bad decisions.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In 2014, the VA awarded $142 million in bonuses to its employees, including bonuses to the executives who oversaw construction of the Denver VA hospital that was more than $1 billion over budget.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Two other VA executives even abused their authority to obtain $400,000 in relocation benefits.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It doesn't have to be this way.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: As Veteran Affairs Chairman Jeff Miller said: The VA is not sacred.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here is my 10 step plan to ensure quality, timely care for every Veteran in America: One: I will appoint a Secretary of Veterans Affairs who will make it his or her personal mission to clean up the VA.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Secretary's sole mandate will be to serve our Veterans – not bureaucrats, not politicians, but Veterans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Amazingly, President Obama's VA Secretary recently downplayed concerns about waiting times by saying that people also wait in line at Disneyland.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The attacks on our police, and the terrorism in our cities, threaten our very way of life.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Any politician who does not grasp this danger is not fit to lead our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Americans watching this address tonight have seen the recent images of violence in our streets and the chaos in our communities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Many have witnessed this violence personally, some have even been its victims.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have a message for all of you: the crime and violence that today afflicts our nation will soon come to an end.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Beginning on January 20th 2017, safety will be restored.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The most basic duty of government is to defend the lives of its own citizens.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Any government that fails to do so is a government unworthy to lead.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is finally time for a straightforward assessment of the state of our nation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will present the facts plainly and honestly.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We cannot afford to be so politically correct anymore.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: So if you want to hear the corporate spin, the carefully-crafted lies, and the media myths the Democrats are holding their convention next week.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But here, at our convention, there will be no lies.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will honor the American people with the truth, and nothing else.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: These are the facts: Decades of progress made in bringing down crime are now being reversed by this Administration’s rollback of criminal enforcement.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Homicides last year increased by 17% in America’s fifty largest cities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That’s the largest increase in 25 years.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In our nation’s capital, killings have risen by 50 percent.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They are up nearly 60% in nearby Baltimore.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In the President’s hometown of Chicago, more than 2,000 have been the victims of shootings this year alone.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And more than 3,600 have been killed in the Chicago area since he took office.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The number of police officers killed in the line of duty has risen by almost 50% compared to this point last year.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Nearly 180,000 illegal immigrants with criminal records, ordered deported from our country, are tonight roaming free to threaten peaceful citizens.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The number of new illegal immigrant families who have crossed the border so far this year already exceeds the entire total from 2015.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They are being released by the tens of thousands into our communities with no regard for the impact on public safety or resources.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: One such border-crosser was released and made his way to Nebraska.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: There, he ended the life of an innocent young girl named Sarah Root.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She was 21 years-old, and was killed the day after graduating from college with a 4.0 Grade Point Average.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Her killer was then released a second time, and he is now a fugitive from the law.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I’ve met Sarah’s beautiful family.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But to this Administration, their amazing daughter was just one more American life that wasn’t worth protecting.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: One more child to sacrifice on the altar of open borders.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: What about our economy?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Again, I will tell you the plain facts that have been edited out of your nightly news and your morning newspaper: Nearly four in 10 African-American children are living in poverty, while 58% of African American youth are not employed.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: 2 million more Latinos are in poverty today than when the President took his oath of office less than eight years ago.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Another 14 million people have left the workforce entirely.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Household incomes are down more than $4,000 since the year 2000.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our manufacturing trade deficit has reached an all-time high – nearly $800 billion in a single year.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The budget is no better.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: President Obama has doubled our national debt to more than $19 trillion, and growing.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Yet, what do we have to show for it?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our roads and bridges are falling apart, our airports are in Third World condition, and forty-three million Americans are on food stamps.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Now let us consider the state of affairs abroad.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Not only have our citizens endured domestic disaster, but they have lived through one international humiliation after another.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We all remember the images of our sailors being forced to their knees by their Iranian captors at gunpoint.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This was just prior to the signing of the Iran deal, which gave back to Iran $150 billion and gave us nothing – it will go down in history as one of the worst deals ever made.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Another humiliation came when president Obama drew a red line in Syria – and the whole world knew it meant nothing.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In Libya, our consulate – the symbol of American prestige around the globe – was brought down in flames.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: America is far less safe – and the world is far less stable – than when Obama made the decision to put Hillary Clinton in charge of America’s foreign policy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am certain it is a decision he truly regrets.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Her bad instincts and her bad judgment – something pointed out by Bernie Sanders – are what caused the disasters unfolding today.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Let’s review the record.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In 2009, pre-Hillary, ISIS was not even on the map.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: After four years of Hillary Clinton, what do we have?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: ISIS has spread across the region, and the world.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Libya is in ruins, and our Ambassador and his staff were left helpless to die at the hands of savage killers.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Egypt was turned over to the radical Muslim brotherhood, forcing the military to retake control.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Iraq is in chaos.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Iran is on the path to nuclear weapons.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Syria is engulfed in a civil war and a refugee crisis that now threatens the West.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: After fifteen years of wars in the Middle East, after trillions of dollars spent and thousands of lives lost, the situation is worse than it has ever been before.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is the legacy of Hillary Clinton: death, destruction and weakness.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But Hillary Clinton’s legacy does not have to be America’s legacy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The problems we face now – poverty and violence at home, war and destruction abroad – will last only as long as we continue relying on the same politicians who created them.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: A change in leadership is required to change these outcomes.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Tonight, I will share with you my plan of action for America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The most important difference between our plan and that of our opponents, is that our plan will put America First.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: As long as we are led by politicians who will not put America First, then we can be assured that other nations will not treat America with respect.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This will all change in 2017.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The American People will come first once again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My plan will begin with safety at home – which means safe neighborhoods, secure borders, and protection from terrorism.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: There can be no prosperity without law and order.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On the economy, I will outline reforms to add millions of new jobs and trillions in new wealth that can be used to rebuild America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: A number of these reforms that I will outline tonight will be opposed by some of our nation’s most powerful special interests.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That is because these interests have rigged our political and economic system for their exclusive benefit.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Big business, elite media and major donors are lining up behind the campaign of my opponent because they know she will keep our rigged system in place.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They are throwing money at her because they have total control over everything she does.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She is their puppet, and they pull the strings.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That is why Hillary Clinton’s message is that things will never change.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My message is that things have to change – and they have to change right now.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every day I wake up determined to deliver for the people I have met all across this nation that have been neglected, ignored, and abandoned.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have visited the laid-off factory workers, and the communities crushed by our horrible and unfair trade deals.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: These are the forgotten men and women of our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: People who work hard but no longer have a voice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have embraced crying mothers who have lost their children because our politicians put their personal agendas before the national good.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: When innocent people suffer, because our political system lacks the will, or the courage, or the basic decency to enforce our laws – or worse still, has sold out to some corporate lobbyist for cash – I am not able to look the other way.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And when a Secretary of State illegally stores her emails on a private server, deletes 33,000 of them so the authorities can’t see her crime, puts our country at risk, lies about it in every different form and faces no consequence – I know that corruption has reached a level like never before.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: When the FBI Director says that the Secretary of State was “extremely careless” and “negligent,” in handling our classified secrets, I also know that these terms are minor compared to what she actually did.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They were just used to save her from facing justice for her terrible crimes.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In fact, her single greatest accomplishment may be committing such an egregious crime and getting away with it – especially when others have paid so dearly.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: When that same Secretary of State rakes in millions of dollars trading access and favors to special interests and foreign powers I know the time for action has come.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have joined the political arena so that the powerful can no longer beat up on people that cannot defend themselves.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Nobody knows the system better than me, which is why I alone can fix it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have seen firsthand how the system is rigged against our citizens, just like it was rigged against Bernie Sanders – he never had a chance.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But his supporters will join our movement, because we will fix his biggest issue: trade.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Millions of Democrats will join our movement because we are going to fix the system so it works for all Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In this cause, I am proud to have at my side the next Vice President of the United States: Governor Mike Pence of Indiana.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will bring the same economic success to America that Mike brought to Indiana.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: He is a man of character and accomplishment.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: He is the right man for the job.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The first task for our new Administration will be to liberate our citizens from the crime and terrorism and lawlessness that threatens their communities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: America was shocked to its core when our police officers in Dallas were brutally executed.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In the days after Dallas, we have seen continued threats and violence against our law enforcement officials.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Law officers have been shot or killed in recent days in Georgia, Missouri, Wisconsin, Kansas, Michigan and Tennessee.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On Sunday, more police were gunned down in Baton Rouge, Louisiana.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Three were killed, and four were badly injured.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: An attack on law enforcement is an attack on all Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have a message to every last person threatening the peace on our streets and the safety of our police: when I take the oath of office next year, I will restore law and order our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will work with, and appoint, the best prosecutors and law enforcement officials in the country to get the job done.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In this race for the White House, I am the Law And Order candidate.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The irresponsible rhetoric of our President, who has used the pulpit of the presidency to divide us by race and color, has made America a more dangerous environment for everyone.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This Administration has failed America’s inner cities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s failed them on education.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s failed them on jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s failed them on crime.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s failed them at every level.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: When I am President, I will work to ensure that all of our kids are treated equally, and protected equally.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every action I take, I will ask myself: does this make life better for young Americans in Baltimore, Chicago, Detroit, Ferguson who have as much of a right to live out their dreams as any other child America?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To make life safe in America, we must also address the growing threats we face from outside America: we are going to defeat the barbarians of ISIS.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Once again, France is the victim of brutal Islamic terrorism.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Men, women and children viciously mowed down.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: A nation in mourning.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The damage and devastation that can be inflicted by Islamic radicals has been over and over – at the World Trade Center, at an office party in San Bernardino, at the Boston Marathon, and a military recruiting center in Chattanooga, Tennessee.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Only weeks ago, in Orlando, Florida, 49 wonderful Americans were savagely murdered by an Islamic terrorist.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This time, the terrorist targeted our LGBT community.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: As your President, I will do everything in my power to protect our LGBT citizens from the violence and oppression of a hateful foreign ideology.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To protect us from terrorism, we need to focus on three things.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We must have the best intelligence gathering operation in the world.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We must abandon the failed policy of nation building and regime change that Hillary Clinton pushed in Iraq, Libya, Egypt and Syria.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Instead, we must work with all of our allies who share our goal of destroying ISIS and stamping out Islamic terror.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This includes working with our greatest ally in the region, the State of Israel.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Lastly, we must immediately suspend immigration from any nation that has been compromised by terrorism until such time as proven vetting mechanisms have been put in place.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My opponent has called for a radical 550% increase in Syrian refugees on top of existing massive refugee flows coming into our country under President Obama.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She proposes this despite the fact that there’s no way to screen these refugees in order to find out who they are or where they come from.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I only want to admit individuals into our country who will support our values and love our people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Anyone who endorses violence, hatred or oppression is not welcome in our country and never will be.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Decades of record immigration have produced lower wages and higher unemployment for our citizens, especially for African-American and Latino workers.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to have an immigration system that works, but one that works for the American people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On Monday, we heard from three parents whose children were killed by illegal immigrants Mary Ann Mendoza, Sabine Durden, and Jamiel Shaw.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They are just three brave representatives of many thousands.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Of all my travels in this country, nothing has affected me more deeply than the time I have spent with the mothers and fathers who have lost their children to violence spilling across our border.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: These families have no special interests to represent them.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: There are no demonstrators to protest on their behalf.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My opponent will never meet with them, or share in their pain.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Instead, my opponent wants Sanctuary Cities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But where was sanctuary for Kate Steinle?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Where was Sanctuary for the children of Mary Ann, Sabine and Jamiel?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Where was sanctuary for all the other Americans who have been so brutally murdered, and who have suffered so horribly?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: These wounded American families have been alone.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But they are alone no longer.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Tonight, this candidate and this whole nation stand in their corner to support them, to send them our love, and to pledge in their honor that we will save countless more families from suffering the same awful fate.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to build a great border wall to stop illegal immigration, to stop the gangs and the violence, and to stop the drugs from pouring into our communities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have been honored to receive the endorsement of America’s Border Patrol Agents, and will work directly with them to protect the integrity of our lawful immigration system.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: By ending catch-and-release on the border, we will stop the cycle of human smuggling and violence.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Illegal border crossings will go down.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Peace will be restored.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: By enforcing the rules for the millions who overstay their visas, our laws will finally receive the respect they deserve.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Tonight, I want every American whose demands for immigration security have been denied – and every politician who has denied them – to listen very closely to the words I am about to say.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On January 21st of 2017, the day after I take the oath of office, Americans will finally wake up in a country where the laws of the United States are enforced.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to be considerate and compassionate to everyone.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But my greatest compassion will be for our own struggling citizens.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My plan is the exact opposite of the radical and dangerous immigration policy of Hillary Clinton.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Americans want relief from uncontrolled immigration.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Yet Hillary Clinton is proposing mass amnesty, mass immigration, and mass lawlessness.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Her plan will overwhelm your schools and hospitals, further reduce your jobs and wages, and make it harder for recent immigrants to escape from poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have a different vision for our workers.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It begins with a new, fair trade policy that protects our jobs and stands up to countries that cheat.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s been a signature message of my campaign from day one, and it will be a signature feature of my presidency from the moment I take the oath of office.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have made billions of dollars in business making deals – now I’m going to make our country rich again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am going to turn our bad trade agreements into great ones.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: America has lost nearly-one third of its manufacturing jobs since 1997, following the enactment of disastrous trade deals supported by Bill and Hillary Clinton.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Remember, it was Bill Clinton who signed NAFTA, one of the worst economic deals ever made by our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am going to bring our jobs back to Ohio and to America – and I am not going to let companies move to other countries, firing their employees along the way, without consequences.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My opponent, on the other hand, has supported virtually every trade agreement that has been destroying our middle class.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She supported NAFTA, and she supported China’s entrance into the World Trade Organization – another one of her husband’s colossal mistakes.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She supported the job killing trade deal with South Korea.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She has supported the Trans-Pacific Partnership.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The TPP will not only destroy our manufacturing, but it will make America subject to the rulings of foreign governments.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I pledge to never sign any trade agreement that hurts our workers, or that diminishes our freedom and independence.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Instead, I will make individual deals with individual countries.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: No longer will we enter into these massive deals, with many countries, that are thousands of pages long – and which no one from our country even reads or understands.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to enforce all trade violations, including through the use of taxes and tariffs, against any country that cheats.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This includes stopping China’s outrageous theft of intellectual property, along with their illegal product dumping, and their devastating currency manipulation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our horrible trade agreements with China and many others, will be totally renegotiated.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That includes renegotiating NAFTA to get a much better deal for America – and we’ll walk away if we don’t get the deal that we want.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to start building and making things again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Next comes the reform of our tax laws, regulations and energy rules.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: While Hillary Clinton plans a massive tax increase, I have proposed the largest tax reduction of any candidate who has declared for the presidential race this year – Democrat or Republican.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Middle-income Americans will experience profound relief, and taxes will be simplified for everyone.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: America is one of the highest-taxed nations in the world.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Reducing taxes will cause new companies and new jobs to come roaring back into our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Then we are going to deal with the issue of regulation, one of the greatest job-killers of them all.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Excessive regulation is costing our country as much as $2 trillion a year, and we will end it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to lift the restrictions on the production of American energy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This will produce more than $20 trillion in job creating economic activity over the next four decades.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My opponent, on the other hand, wants to put the great miners and steel workers of our country out of work – that will never happen when I am President.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: With these new economic policies, trillions of dollars will start flowing into our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This new wealth will improve the quality of life for all Americans – We will build the roads, highways, bridges, tunnels, airports, and the railways of tomorrow.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This, in turn, will create millions more jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will rescue kids from failing schools by helping their parents send them to a safe school of their choice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My opponent would rather protect education bureaucrats than serve American children.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will repeal and replace disastrous Obamacare.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: You will be able to choose your own doctor again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And we will fix TSA at the airports!

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will completely rebuild our depleted military, and the countries that we protect, at a massive loss, will be asked to pay their fair share.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will take care of our great Veterans like they have never been taken care of before.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My opponent dismissed the VA scandal as being not widespread – one more sign of how out of touch she really is.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to ask every Department Head in government to provide a list of wasteful spending projects that we can eliminate in my first 100 days.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The politicians have talked about it, I’m going to do it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are also going to appoint justices to the United States Supreme Court who will uphold our laws and our Constitution.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The replacement for Justice Scalia will be a person of similar views and principles.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This will be one of the most important issues decided by this election.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My opponent wants to essentially abolish the 2nd amendment.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I, on the other hand, received the early and strong endorsement of the National Rifle Association and will protect the right of all Americans to keep their families safe.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: At this moment, I would like to thank the evangelical community who have been so good to me and so supportive.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: You have so much to contribute to our politics, yet our laws prevent you from speaking your minds from your own pulpits.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: An amendment, pushed by Lyndon Johnson, many years ago, threatens religious institutions with a loss of their tax-exempt status if they openly advocate their political views.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am going to work very hard to repeal that language and protect free speech for all Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We can accomplish these great things, and so much else – all we need to do is start believing in ourselves and in our country again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is time to show the whole world that America is back – bigger, and better and stronger than ever before.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In this journey, I'm so lucky to have at my side my wife Melania and my wonderful children, Don, Ivanka, Eric, Tiffany, and Barron: you will always be my greatest source of pride and joy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My Dad, Fred Trump, was the smartest and hardest working man I ever knew.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I wonder sometimes what he’d say if he were here to see this tonight.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s because of him that I learned, from my youngest age, to respect the dignity of work and the dignity of working people.

speaker: Donald Trump
