text: I care too much about my country to let that happen.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We all care too much about our country to let that happen.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Good policing saves lives.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My dear friend, Rudy Giuliani, knows a thing or two about this.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The policies put into place by Rudy ultimately brought down crime by 76 percent and murder by 84 percent.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Think of how many families were saved, how much heartache was prevented, when police were put into communities and criminals were removed.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Imagine how many lives could have been saved, all across this country, if Democratic politicians hadn't blocked in their cities what Rudy did in New York City?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I'll make sure we deliver safe neighborhoods here in Milwaukee, and all across this country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's easy for Hillary Clinton to turn a blind eye to crime when she has her own private security force.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I believe all Americans, not just the powerful, are entitled to security.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton has had her chance.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Now it's time for new leadership.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Hillary Clinton agenda hurts poor people the most.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: There is no compassion in allowing drug dealers, gang members, and felons to prey on innocent people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is the first duty of government to keep the innocent safe, and when I am President I will fight for the safety of every American – and especially those Americans who have not known safety for a very, very long time.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am asking for the vote of every African-American citizen struggling in our country today who wants a different future.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is time for our society to address some honest and very difficult truths.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Democratic Party has failed and betrayed the African-American community.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Democratic crime policies, education policies, and economic policies have produced only more crime, more broken homes, and more poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Let us look at the situation right here in Milwaukee, a city run by Democrats for decade after decade.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Last year, killings in this city increased by 69 percent, plus another 634 victims of non-fatal shootings.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: 18-29-year-olds accounted for nearly half of the homicide victims.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The poverty rate here is nearly double the national average.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Almost 4 in 10 African-American men in Milwaukee between the ages of 25-54 do not have a job.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Nearly four in 10 single mother households are living in poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: 55 public schools in this city have been rated as failing to meet expectations, despite ten thousand dollars in funding per-pupil.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: There is only a 60% graduation rate, and it's one of the worst public school systems in the country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: 1 in 5 manufacturing jobs has disappeared in Milwaukee since we fully opened our markets to China, and many African-American neighborhoods have borne the brunt of this hit.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To every voter in Milwaukee, to every voter living in every inner city, or every forgotten stretch of our society, I am running to offer you a better future.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Democratic Party has taken the votes of African-Americans for granted.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They've just assumed they'll get your support and done nothing in return for it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's time to give the Democrats some competition for these votes, and it's time to rebuild the inner cities of America – and to reject the failed leadership of a rigged political system.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I'm not part of the corrupt system.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In fact, the corrupt system is trying to stop me.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I've been paying my own way.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The voters in the Republican Party this year defied the donors, the consultants, the power brokers, and choose a nominee from outside our failed and corrupt and broken system.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The other party – the Democratic Party – nominated the personification of special interest corruption.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Democratic Party rigged the nomination to give it to Hillary Clinton, thus giving the soul of their party this year to the special interests.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am running to listen to your voice, to hear your cries for help.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The quiet voices in our society, not the loudest demonstrators, need to have their demands heard.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Fair and equal representation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We reject the bigotry of Hillary Clinton which panders to and talks down to communities of color and sees them only as votes, not as individual human beings worthy of a better future.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She doesn't care at all about the hurting people of this country, or the suffering she has caused them.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The African-American community has been taken for granted for decades by the Democratic Party.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's time to break with the failures of the past – I want to offer Americans a new future.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is time for rule by the people, not rule by special interests.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every insider, getting rich off of our broken system, is throwing money at Hillary Clinton.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The hedge fund managers, the Wall Street investors, the professional political class.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's the powerful protecting the powerful.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Insiders fighting for insiders.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am fighting for you.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: When we talk about the insider, who are we talking about?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's the comfortable politicians looking out for their own interests.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's the lobbyists who know how to insert that perfect loophole into every bill.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's the financial industry that knows how to regulate their competition out of existence.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The insiders also include the media executives, anchors and journalists in Washington, Los Angeles, and New York City, who are part of the same failed status quo and want nothing to change.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every day you pick up a newspaper, or turn on the nightly news, and you hear about some self-interest banker or some discredited Washington insider says they oppose our campaign.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Or some encrusted old politician says they oppose our campaign.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Or some big time lobbyist says they oppose our campaign.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I wear their opposition as a badge of honor.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Because it means I am fighting for REAL change, not just partisan change.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am fighting – all of us across the country are fighting – for peaceful regime change in our own country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The media-donor-political complex that's bled this country dry has to be replaced with a new government of, by and for the people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The leadership class in Washington D.C., of which Hillary Clinton has been a member for thirty years, has abandoned the people of this country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am going to give the people their voice back.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The people opposing our campaign are the same people who have left our border open and let innocent people suffer as a result.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The people opposing our campaign are the same people who have led us into one disastrous foreign war after another.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The people opposing our campaign are the same people who lied to us about one trade deal after another.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Aren't you tired of a system that gets rich at your expense?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Aren't you tired of big media, big businesses, and big donors rigging the system to keep your voice from being heard?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Are you ready for change?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Are you ready for leadership that puts you, the American people, first?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That puts your country first?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That puts your family first?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Let's talk about what this means for the inner cities of America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's time to break through the television noise, the entrenched interests.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I understand that a lot of powerful people in our political system – a lot of people who've created our problems – will lose a lot of their contracts, and their special gigs, if African-American voters, and all minority voters, support my campaign.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's time to stop making the special interests rich.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's time to make the American people rich.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am going to Make America Wealthy again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Democratic Party has run nearly every inner city in this country for 50 years, and run them into financial ruin.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They've ruined the schools.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They've driven out the jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They've tolerated a level of crime no American should consider acceptable.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Violent crime has risen 17% in America's 50 largest cities last year.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Killings of police officers this year is up nearly 50 percent.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Homicides are up more than 60% in Baltimore.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They are up more than 50% in Washington, D.C.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is the future offered by Hillary Clinton.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: More poverty, more crime, and more of the same.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The future she offers is the most pessimistic thing I can possibly imagine.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is time for a different future.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here is what I am proposing.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: No community in this country has been hurt worse by Hillary Clinton's immigration policies than the African-American community.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Now she is proposing to print instant work permits for millions of illegal immigrants, taking jobs directly from low-income Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will secure our border, protect our workers, and improve jobs and wages in your community.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will only invite people to join our country who share our tolerant values, who support our Constitution, and who love all of our people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On trade, I am going to renegotiate NAFTA, stand up to China, withdraw from the TPP, and protect every last American job.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On taxes, I am going to give a massive tax cut to every worker and small business in this country, bring thousands of new companies and millions of new jobs onto our shores – and make it very difficult for our businesses to leave.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am going to reform our regulations so jobs stay in America, and new businesses come to America to hire workers right here in Milwaukee.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every policy my opponent has sends jobs overseas.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am going to bring trillions in new wealth back to the United States.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On education, it is time to have school choice, merit pay for teachers, and to end the tenure policies that hurt good teachers and reward bad teachers.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to put students and parents first.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton would rather deny opportunities to millions of young African-American children, just so she can curry favor with the education bureaucracy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am going to allow charter schools to thrive, and help young kids get on the American ladder of success: a good education, and a good-paying job.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On crime, I am going to support more police in our communities, appoint the best prosecutors and judges in the country, pursue strong enforcement of federal laws, and I am going to break up the gangs, the cartels and criminal syndicates terrorizing our neighborhoods.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To every lawbreaker hurting innocent people in this country, I say: your free reign will soon come crashing to an end.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On healthcare, we are going to get rid of Obamacare – which has caused soaring double-digit premium increases – and give choice to patients and consumers.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Aetna, just today, announced they are dropping out – as are many of the major insurance companies.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On government corruption, I am going to restore honor to our government.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We've seen the corruption of Hillary Clinton, the mass email deletions, the pay-for-play at the State Department, the profiteering, the favors given to foreign corporations and governments at your expense.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We've seen a former Secretary of State lie to Congress about her illegal email scheme, risk innocent American lives, and bring dishonor onto our government.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In my Administration, I am going to enforce all laws concerning the protection of classified information.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: No one will be above the law.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am going to forbid senior officials from trading favors for cash by preventing them from collecting lavish speaking fees through their spouses when they serve.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am going to ask my senior officials to sign an agreement not to accept speaking fees from corporations with a registered lobbyist for five years after leaving office, or from any entity tied to a foreign government.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is all just the beginning.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to make this a government of the people once again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is our chance to take back power from all the people who've taken it from you.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The reason you see the establishment media lining up behind my opponent is because they are scared that you, with your vote, can take away their power and return it to your family and community.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: These are tough times.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But I know we can make American Greater Than Ever Before.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To do this, we are going to need a fighter in the White House.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will be your fighter.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To defeat crime and Radical Islamic Terrorism in our country, to win trade in our country, you need tremendous physical and mental strength and stamina.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton doesn't have that strength and stamina.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She cannot win for you.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Most importantly, she has bad judgment.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Bad judgment on terrorism, bad judgement on foreign policy, bad judgment on trade.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The only individuals she's ever delivered for is her donors – not the people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I've said it before, and I'll say it again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My opponent asks her supporters to repeat a three-word pledge.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Her pledge reads: I'm With Her I choose to recite a different pledge.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My pledge reads: I'm With You – the American people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will fight to ensure that every American is treated equally, protected equally, and honored equally.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will reject bigotry and hatred and oppression in all of its forms, and seek a new future of security, prosperity and opportunity – a future built on our common culture and values as one American people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are one country, one people, and we will have together one great future.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Tonight, I’d like to talk about the New American Future we are going to create together.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Last week, I laid out my plan to bring jobs back to our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On Monday, I laid out my plan to defeat Radical Islamic Terrorism.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On Tuesday, in Wisconsin, I talked about how we are going to restore law and order to this country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Let me take this opportunity to extend our thanks and our gratitude to the police and law enforcement officers in this country who have sacrificed so greatly in these difficult times.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The chaos and violence on our streets, and the assaults on law enforcement, are an attack against all peaceful citizens.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: If I am elected President, this chaos and violence will end – and it will end very quickly.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every single citizen in our land has a right to live in safety.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To be one united nation, we must protect all of our people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But we must also provide opportunities for all of our people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We cannot make America Great Again if we leave any community behind.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Nearly Four in ten African-American children are living in poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will not rest until children of every color in this country are fully included in the American Dream.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is what I promise to African-Americans, Hispanic-Americans, and all Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But to achieve this New American Future we must break from the failures of the past.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: As you know, I am not a politician.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have worked in business, creating jobs and rebuilding neighborhoods my entire adult life.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I’ve never wanted to learn the language of the insiders, and I’ve never been politically correct – it takes far too much time, and can often make it more difficult to achieve total victory.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Sometimes, in the heat of debate and speaking on a multitude of issues, you don’t choose the right words or you say the wrong thing.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have done that, and I regret it, particularly where it may have caused personal pain.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Too much is at stake for us to be consumed with these issues.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But one thing I can promise you is this: I will always tell you the truth.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I speak the truth for all of you, and for everyone in this country who doesn’t have a voice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I speak the truth on behalf of the factory worker who lost his or her job.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I speak the truth on behalf of the Veteran who has been denied the medical care they need – and so many are not making it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I speak the truth on behalf of the family living near the border that deserves to be safe in their own country but is instead living with no security at all.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our campaign is about representing the great majority of Americans – Republicans, Democrats, Independents, Conservatives and Liberals – who read the newspaper, or turn on the TV, and don’t hear anyone speaking for them.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: All they hear are insiders fighting for insiders.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: These are the forgotten men and women in our society, and they are angry at so much on so many levels.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The poverty, the unemployment, the failing schools, the jobs moving to other countries.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am fighting for these forgotten Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Fourteen months ago, I declared my campaign for the Presidency on the promise to give our government back to the people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every day since then, I’ve worked to repay the loyalty and the faith that you have put in me.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every day I think about how much is at stake for this country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This isn’t just the fight of my life, it’s the fight of our lives – together – to save our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I refuse to let another generation of American children be excluded from the American Dream.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our whole country loses when young people of limitless potential are denied the opportunity to contribute their talents because we failed to provide them the opportunities they deserved.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Let our children be dreamers too.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our whole country loses every time a kid doesn’t graduate from high school, or fails to enter the workforce or, worse still, is lost to the dreadful world of drugs and crime.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: When I look at the failing schools, the terrible trade deals, and the infrastructure crumbling in our inner cities, I know all of this can be fixed - and it can be fixed very quickly.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In the world I come from, if something is broken, you fix it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: If something isn’t working, you replace it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: If a product doesn’t deliver, you make a change.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That’s why I am running: to end the decades of bitter failure and to offer the American people a new future of honesty, justice and opportunity.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: A future where America, and its people, always – and I mean always – come first.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Aren’t you tired of a system that gets rich at your expense?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Aren’t you tired of the same old lies and the same old broken promises?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And Hillary Clinton has proven to be one of the greatest liars of all time.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Aren’t you tired of arrogant leaders who look down on you, instead of serving and protecting you?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That is all about to change – and it’s about to change soon.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to put the American people first again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I’ve travelled all across this country laying out my bold and modern agenda for change.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In this journey, I will never lie to you.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will never tell you something I do not believe.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will never put anyone’s interests ahead of yours.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And, I will never, ever stop fighting for you.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have no special interest.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am spending millions of dollars on my own campaign – nobody else is.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My only interest is the American people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: So while sometimes I can be too honest, Hillary Clinton is the exact opposite: she never tells the truth.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: One lie after another, and getting worse each passing day.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The American people are still waiting for Hillary Clinton to apologize for all of the many lies she’s told to them, and the many times she’s betrayed them.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Tell me, has Hillary Clinton ever apologized for lying about her illegal email server and deleting 33,000 emails?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Has Hillary Clinton apologized for turning the State Department into a pay-for-play operation where favors are sold to the highest bidder?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Has she apologized for lying to the families who lost loved ones at Benghazi?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Has she apologized for putting Iran on the path to nuclear weapons?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Has she apologized for Iraq?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Has she apologized for unleashing ISIS across the world?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Has Hillary Clinton apologized for the decisions she made that have led to so much death, destruction and terrorism?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Speaking of lies, we now know from the State Department announcement that President Obama lied about the $400 million dollars in cash that was flown to Iran.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: He denied it was for the hostages, but it was.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: He said we don’t pay ransom, but he did.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: He lied about the hostages – openly and blatantly – just like he lied about Obamacare.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Now the Administration has put every American travelling overseas, including our military personnel, at greater risk of being kidnapped.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton owns President Obama’s Iran policy, one more reason she can never be allowed to be President.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Let’s talk about the economy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here, in this beautiful state, so many people have suffered because of NAFTA.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Bill Clinton signed the deal, and Hillary Clinton supported it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: North Carolina has lost nearly half of its manufacturing jobs since NAFTA went into effect.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Bill Clinton also put China into the World Trade Organization – another Hillary Clinton-backed deal.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Your city of Charlotte has lost 1 in 4 manufacturing jobs since China joined the WTO, and many of these jobs were lost while Hillary Clinton was Secretary of State – our chief diplomat with China.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She was a disaster, totally unfit for the job.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton owes the State of North Carolina a very big apology, and I think you’ll get that apology around the same time you’ll get to see her 33,000 deleted emails.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Another major issue in this campaign has been the border.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our open border has allowed drugs and crime and gangs to pour into our communities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: So much needless suffering, so much preventable death.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I’ve spent time with the families of wonderful Americans whose loved ones were killed by the open borders and Sanctuary Cities that Hillary Clinton supports.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I’ve embraced the crying parents who’ve lost their children to violence spilling across our border.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Parents like Laura Wilkerson and Michelle Root and Sabine Durden and Jamiel Shaw whose children were killed by illegal immigrants.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My opponent supports Sanctuary Cities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But where was the Sanctuary for Kate Steinle?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Where was the Sanctuary for the children of Laura, Michelle, Sabine and Jamiel?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Where was the Sanctuary for every other parent who has suffered so horribly?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: These moms and dads don’t get a lot of consideration from our politicians.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They certainly don’t get apologies.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They’ll never even get the time of day from Hillary Clinton.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But they will always come first to me.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Listen closely: we will deliver justice for all of these American Families.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will create a system of immigration that makes us all proud.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton’s mistakes destroy innocent lives, sacrifice national security, and betray the working families of this country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Please remember this: I will never put personal profit before national security.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will never leave our border open to appease donors and special interests.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will never support a trade deal that kills American jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will never put the special interests before the national interest.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will never put a donor before a voter, or a lobbyist before a citizen.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Instead, I will be a champion for the people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The establishment media doesn’t cover what really matters in this country, or what’s really going on in people’s lives.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They will take words of mine out of context and spend a week obsessing over every single syllable, and then pretend to discover some hidden meaning in what I said.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Just imagine for a second if the media spent this energy holding the politicians accountable who got innocent Americans like Kate Steinle killed – she was gunned down by an illegal immigrant who had been deported five times.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Just imagine if the media spent this much time investigating the poverty and joblessness in our inner cities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Just think about how much different things would be if the media in this country sent their cameras to our border, or to our closing factories, or to our failing schools.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Or if the media focused on what dark secrets must be hidden in the 33,000 emails Hillary Clinton deleted.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Instead, every story is told from the perspective of the insiders.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s the narrative of the people who rigged the system, never the voice of the people it’s been rigged against.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: So many people suffering in silence.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: No cameras, no coverage, no outrage from a media class that seems to get outraged over just about everything else.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: So again, it’s not about me.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s never been about me.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s about all the people in this country who don’t have a voice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am running to be their voice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am running to be the voice for every forgotten part of this country that has been waiting and hoping for a better future.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am glad that I make the powerful a little uncomfortable now and again – including some powerful people in my own party.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Because it means I am fighting for real change.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: There’s a reason the hedge fund managers, the financial lobbyists, the Wall Street investors, are throwing their money at Hillary Clinton.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Because they know she will make sure the system stays rigged in their favor.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It’s the powerful protecting the powerful.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The insiders fighting for the insiders.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here is the change I propose.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On terrorism, we are going to end the era of nation-building and instead focus on destroying ISIS and Radical Islamic terrorism.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will use military, cyber and financial warfare and work with any partner in the world, and the Middle East, that shares our goal of defeating terrorism.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have a message for the terrorists trying to kill our citizens: we will find you, we will destroy you, and we will win.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On immigration, we will temporarily suspend immigration from any place where adequate screening cannot be performed.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: All applicants for immigration will be vetted for ties to radical ideology, and we will screen out anyone who doesn’t share our values and love our people.

speaker: Donald Trump

text: Meanwhile, massive portions of our country are in a state of disrepair.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's time to rebuild America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Too many Americans living in our inner cities have not been included in the American Dream.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are one nation, and when any part of our country hurts – our whole country hurts.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My goal as President will be to ensure that every child in this nation – African-American, Hispanic-American, all Americans – will be placed on the ladder of success: a great education, and a great job.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That ladder rests on a fundamental foundation: safety.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In order to help our children succeed, our first duty is to ensure that every kid in America can grow up in a safe community.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: You can't have prosperity without security.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is the new civil rights agenda of our time.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The right to a safe community, a quality education, and a secure job.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our campaign represents the long-awaited chance to break with the bitter failures of the past, and to embrace a New American Future.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: There is no failed policy more in need of urgent change than our government-run education monopoly.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Democratic Party has trapped millions of African-American and Hispanic youth in failing government schools that deny them the opportunity to join the ladder of American success.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is time to break-up that monopoly.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I want every single inner city child in America who is today trapped in a failing school to have the freedom – the civil right – to attend the school of their choice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This includes private schools, traditional public schools, magnet schools and charter schools which must be included in any definition of school choice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our government spends more than enough money to easily pay for this initiative – with billions left over.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's simply a matter of putting students first, not the education bureaucracy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Let's run through the numbers.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: At the state and federal level, the United States spends more than $620 billion on K-12 education each year.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That's an average of about $12,296 for every student enrolled in our elementary and secondary public schools.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The federal government pays for about 10 percent—$64 billion, to be precise—of the K-12 costs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That $64 billion makes up about half of the total spending of the U.S.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The other roughly $570 billion spent on K-12 education comes from the states.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We spend more per student than almost any other major country in the world.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Yet, our students perform near the bottom of the pack for major large advanced countries.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our largest cities spend some of the largest amounts of money on public schools.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: New York City spends $20,226 dollars per pupil.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Baltimore spends $15,287 dollars per student.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Chicago spends $11,976 dollars per student, and in Los Angeles it is $10,602.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Just imagine if each student in these school systems was given a scholarship for this amount of money – allowing them and their family to choose the public or private school of their choice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Not only would this empower families, but it would create a massive education market that is competitive and produces better outcomes.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: These schools would then cater to the needs of the individual student and family – not the needs of the Teachers' Union.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: There is no more important job than a teacher, and teachers will benefit greatly from these reforms.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The current government monopoly, while great for the bureaucrats, has utterly failed too many students.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: According to the National Assessment of Education Progress, only 1 in 6 African-American students in the eighth grade are considered proficient in math and reading.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Failing schools then contribute to failing economies.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In Los Angeles the official unemployment rate for African-American men is almost 20.7 percent.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In Baltimore, it is 16.2 percent, 14.7 percent in Chicago and 10.9 percent in New York City.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In Los Angeles, 26 percent of African American women live in poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In Baltimore, the poverty rate for African Americans is 27 percent.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In New York, over 31 percent of African Americans live in poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Nationwide, nearly 40% of African-American children live in poverty – including 45% of children under the age of six.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our public schools are failing to put young Americans on a path to success.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Meanwhile, we have all seen the tragic rise in crime in these communities – which remains one of the greatest barriers to fostering opportunity and success for America's children.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Violent crime rose more than 20% in Los Angeles in 2015.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Homicides in Baltimore increased by 63%.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: There have been nearly 3,000 victims of shootings in Chicago so far this year.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Government is failing our citizens at every level.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That is why I am proposing a plan to provide school choice to every disadvantaged student in America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That means parents will be able to send their kids to the desired public, private or religious school of their choice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here is how it will work.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Right now, about $1.9 billion is spent on fifty private school choice programs nationwide.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: These are opportunity scholarships, tax credits, and education savings accounts.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This covers about 400,000 students in our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Altogether, school choice is serving more than 3.4 million students nationwide.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Charter schools, in particular, have demonstrated amazing gains and results in providing education to disadvantaged children and the success of these schools will be a top priority for my Administration.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They also produce competition that causes better outcomes for everyone.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My first budget will immediately add an additional federal investment of $20 billion towards school choice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This will be done by reprioritizing existing federal dollars.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Specifically, my plan will use $20 billion of existing federal dollars to establish a block grant for the 11 million school age kids living in poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will give states the option to allow these funds to follow the student to the public or private school they attend.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Distribution of this grant will favor states that have private school choice and charter laws, encouraging them to participate.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This $20 billion will instantly extend choice to millions more students.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: A state like Ohio will benefit greatly from these new funds.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Ohio is a leader in school choice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Ohio has 5 private school choice programs that serve over 30,000 students, and 384 charter schools serving 123,844 students.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But the $20 billion is only the beginning.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: As President, I will establish the national goal of providing school choice to every American child living in poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That means that we want every disadvantaged child to be able to choose the local public, private, charter or magnet school that is best for them and their family.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Each state will develop its own formula, but we want the dollars to follow the student.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: 9 in 10 dollars spent on K-12 education is spent at the state and local level.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To achieve this long-term goal, we will have to make this a shared national mission – to bring hope to every child in every city in this land.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will use the pulpit of the presidency to campaign for this in all 50 states, and I will call upon the American people to elect officials at the city, state and federal level who support school choice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My Administration will partner with the leadership of any inner city in America – Chicago, Baltimore, Detroit – that is willing to run a pilot program to provide school choice to every child in that community.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In Baltimore, for instance, that would mean more than $15,000 funds available per student.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am confident that the politicians will not be able to suppress the will of the people anymore.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: If we can put a man on the moon, dig out the Panama Canal, and win two World Wars, then I have no doubt that we, as a nation, can provide school choice to every disadvantaged child in America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: If the states collectively contribute another $110 billion of their own education budgets toward school choice, on top of the $20 billion in federal dollars, that could provide $12,000 in school choice funds to every K-12 student who today lives in poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The money will follow the student.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That means the student will be able to attend the public, private, charter or magnet school of their choice – and each state will develop its own system that works best for them.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: As your President, I will be the nation's biggest cheerleader for school choice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I understand many stale old politicians will resist.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But it's time for our country to start thinking big once again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We spend too much time quibbling over the smallest words, when we should spend our time dreaming about the great adventures that lie ahead.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will also support merit-pay for teachers, so that we reward great teachers – instead of the failed tenure system that rewards bad teachers and punishes good ones.

speaker: Donald Trump

speaker: Donald Trump

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My plan to lift restrictions on the production of American energy will not only make home energy bills cheaper, but it will add an estimated half a million jobs per year.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: By reducing radical regulation and over-taxation, we can bring thousands of new companies into our poorest communities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Crucially, my trade reforms will create a manufacturing revival in America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We have a nearly $800 billion dollar annual trade deficit with the world – that's money coming straight out of states like Ohio, Pennsylvania, Michigan, Maine, and so many others.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: By ending foreign currency manipulation, product dumping, and other predatory trading practices, we will be able to open thousands of new plants and factories across America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The future is filled with limitless possibilities for our nation, and exciting opportunities for our children.

text: We've had a failed foreign policy.

speaker: Donald Trump

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And, underneath it all, a failed political system that rewards politicians for how many donors they have – or how many journalists they know – not how many Americans they help to live better lives.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But the failures of the past are about to end.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Those failures end beginning on November 8th.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will have One American Nation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will be One American People.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are fighting to give every child, in every forgotten stretch of this country, the chance to live out their dreams in safety and peace.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That means a safe neighborhood, a quality education, and a secure high-paying job.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is how we will rebuild our future.

speaker: Donald Trump

text: Whatever still remains at that time can be used to help offset the costs of higher education.

speaker: Donald Trump

text: I am going to lower you taxes; I am going to get rid of massive amounts of unnecessary regulations, on business and in your life; I'm going to repeal and replace Obamacare; I'm going to appoint Justices to the Supreme Court who will follow the Constitution; I'm going to rebuild our depleted military and take care of our vets; I'm going to save your 2nd amendment [NRA endorsement]; I'm going to stop illegal immigration and drugs coming into our country, and yes, we will build the wall [Mexico will pay]; and I'm going to, so importantly, renegotiate your horrible trade deals, especially NAFTA – which is the single worst trade deal ever made by any country anywhere in the world and a one-way street for jobs out of the United States – and we will make great trade deals that put the American worker first.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will rebuild our water infrastructure, and our EPA will abandon political agendas and focus on its core mission: clean air and safe water.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will put new American steel into the spine of this country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We Will Make America Wealthy Again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Thank you for the opportunity to speak with you.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Today, I'm going to outline a plan for American economic revival – it is a bold, ambitious, forward-looking plan to massively increase jobs, wages, incomes and opportunities for the people of our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My plan will embrace the truth that people flourish under a minimum government burden, and it will tap into the incredible unrealized potential of our workers and their dreams.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Right now, 92 million Americans are on the sidelines, outside the workforce, and not part of our economy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's a silent nation of jobless Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Look no further than the city of Flint, where I just visited.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The jobs have stripped from this community, and its infrastructure has collapsed.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In 1970, there were more than 80,000 people in Flint working for GM – today it is less than 8,000.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Now Ford has announced it is moving all small car production to Mexico.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My economic plan rejects the cynicism that says our labor force will keep declining, that our jobs will keep leaving, and that our economy can never grow as it did once before.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We reject the pessimism that says our standard of living can no longer rise, and that all that's left to do is divide up and redistribute our shrinking resources.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Everything that is broken today can be fixed, and every failure can be turned into a great success.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Jobs can stop leaving our country, and start pouring in.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Failing schools can become flourishing schools.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Crumbling roads and bridges can become gleaming new infrastructure.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Inner cities can experience a flood of new jobs and investment.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And rising crime can give way to safe and prosperous communities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: All of these things, and so much more, are possible.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But to accomplish them, we must replace the present policy of globalism – which has moved so many jobs and so much wealth out of our country – and replace it with a new policy of Americanism.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Under this American System, every policy decision we make must pass a simple test: does it create more jobs and better wages for Americans?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: If we lower our taxes, remove destructive regulations, unleash the vast treasure of American energy, and negotiate trade deals that put America First, then there is no limit to the number of jobs we can create and the amount of prosperity we can unleash.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: America will truly be the greatest place in the world to invest, hire, grow and to create new jobs, new technologies, and entire new industries.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Instead of driving jobs and wealth away, America will become the world's great magnet for innovation and job creation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My opponent's plan rejects this optimism.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She offers only more taxing, regulating, more spending and more wealth redistribution – a future of slow growth, declining incomes, and dwindling prosperity.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The only people who get rich under Hillary Clinton's scheme are the donors and the special interests.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In Hillary Clinton's America, we have surrendered our status as the world's great economy, and we have surrendered our middle class to the whims of foreign countries.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Not one single idea she has will create one net American job, or create one new dollar of American wealth for our workers.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The only thing she can ever offer is a welfare check.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our plan will produce paychecks, and they're going to be great paychecks for millions of people now unemployed.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In the course of this campaign, I have travelled all across this country and I've met the most amazing people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every day, I've seen the goodness and character of our country, and brave citizens proudly fighting through hard times and difficult circumstances.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In many parts of our country, the hard times never seem to end.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I've visited cities and towns in upstate New York where half the jobs have left and moved to other countries.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Politicians have abandoned these places all over our country and the people who live there.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Worse still, politicians have heaped scorn and disdain on these wonderful Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My opponent described tens of millions of American citizens as deplorable and irredeemable – how can Hillary Clinton seek to lead this country when she considers its citizens beyond redemption?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The hardworking people she calls deplorable are the most admirable people I know: they are cops and soldiers, teachers and firefighters, young and old, moms and dads, blacks, whites and Latinos – but above everything else, they are all American.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They love their families, they love their country, and they want a better future.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: These are the forgotten men and women of America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: People who work hard but don't have a voice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am running to be their voice, and to fight to bring prosperity to every part of this country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Too many of our leaders have forgotten that it's their duty to protect the jobs, wages and well-being of American workers before any other consideration.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I'm not running to be President of the world.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I'm running to be President of the United States – and as your President, I will fight for every last American job.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are the nation that tamed the West, dug out the Panama Canal, won two World Wars, and put a man on the moon.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's time to start thinking big once again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That's why I believe it is time to establish a national goal of reaching 4% economic growth.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In working with my economic team, we've put together a plan that puts us on track to achieve that goal.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Over the next ten years, our economic team estimates that under our plan the economy will average 3.5% growth and create a total of 25 million new jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: You can visit our website to see the math.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This growth means that our jobs plan, including our childcare reforms, will be completely paid-for in combination with proposed budget savings.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It will be deficit neutral.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: If we reach 4% growth, it will reduce the deficit.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It will be accomplished through a complete overhaul of our tax, regulatory, energy and trade policies.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Right now, under Obama-Clinton policies, the economy grew only 1.1 percent last quarter – that translates to millions of lost jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is the weakest so-called recovery since the Great Depression.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Over the last 7 years, the economy grew only 2.1 percent, the slowest period in seventy years.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Had the economy grown under Obama at the same rate as Reagan, it would have meant 10 million more jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Perhaps most shockingly, 1 in 6 men aged 18-34 are either in jail or out of work.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Meanwhile, another 2 million Hispanic-Americans have been added to the ranks of those in poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On top of it all, the Obama-Clinton policies have doubled the national debt.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It took more than 230 years for the United States to accumulate it's first $10 trillion dollars in debt – it took President Obama only eight years to add another $10 trillion.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Now, it would be one thing if that money had been used to completely rebuild our nation, our military, and our infrastructure.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Instead, the opposite happened.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We doubled our debt and, in return, we have dilapidated infrastructure, failing schools, a badly depleted military, and another 14 million people who have left the workforce.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Never has so much money been spent so poorly.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But we're going to turn that all around.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It begins with bold new tax reform.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: As outlined in Detroit, our tax plan will greatly simplify the code and reduce the number of brackets from 7 to 3.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The 3 new brackets will be 12, 25 and 33, but low-income Americans will pay no income tax at all – in fact, our plan will remove millions and millions of workers from the income tax rolls entirely.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: By lowering rates, streamlining deductions, and simplifying the process, we will add millions of new jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In addition, because we have strongly capped deductions for the wealthy and closed special interest loopholes, the tax relief will be concentrated on the working and middle class taxpayer.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They will receive the biggest benefit – it won't even be close.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is a working and middle class tax relief proposal.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The tax relief for these workers will be expanded by my childcare proposals that I have worked on with my daughter, Ivanka.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: These proposals are a central element of our comprehensive tax reform and economic growth plan.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Families will be able to fully deduct the average cost of childcare from their taxes, including stay-at-home parents.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Because this deduction is capped, it will disproportionately benefit working and middle class families.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The less you make, the larger a share of your income you can exclude from taxation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Parents will also be able to enroll in tax-free dependent care savings accounts for their children or elderly relatives.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Low-income households will benefit from both an Expanded Earned Income Tax Credit – in the form a Childcare rebate – and a matching $500 contribution for their savings accounts.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: A married couple earning $50,000 per year with two children and $8,000 in child care expenses will save 35% from their current tax bill.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: A married couple earning $75,000 per year with two children and $10,000 in child care expenses will receive a 30% reduction in their tax bill.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: By contrast, someone earning $5 million will receive virtually no change in their tax bill at all.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: One of our greatest job creation measures is going to be our 15% business tax rate – down from the current 35% rate, a reduction of more than 40 percent.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: An explosion of new business and new jobs will be created.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It will be amazing to watch.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will also allow U.S.-based manufacturers to fully expense the cost of new plants and equipment.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On top of that, we will bring back trillions in business wealth parked overseas and tax it at a 10% rate.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Some people say there are $2 trillion dollars overseas, I think it's $5 trillion.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: By taxing it at 10% instead of 35%, all of this money will come back into our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will turn America into a magnet for new jobs – and that means jobs in our poorest communities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: One of the keys to unlocking growth is scaling-back years of disastrous regulations unilaterally imposed by our out-of-control bureaucracy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Regulations have grown into a massive, job-killing industry – and the regulation industry is one business I will put an end to.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In 2015 alone, federal agencies issued over 3,300 final rules and regulations, up from 2,400 the prior year.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every year, overregulation costs our economy $2 trillion dollars a year and reduces household wealth by almost $15,000 dollars.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I've proposed a moratorium on new federal regulations that are not compelled by Congress or public safety, and I will eliminate all needless and job-killing regulations now on the books.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This includes eliminating some of our most intrusive regulations, like the Waters of The U.S. Rule

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It also means scrapping the EPA's so-called Clean Power Plan which the government itself estimates will cost $7.2 billion a year.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This Obama-Clinton directive will shut down most, if not all, coal-powered electricity plans in America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Remember what Hillary Clinton said?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She wants to shut down the miners, just like she wants to shut down the steel mills.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We're going to put our great miners and steel workers back to work.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Energy reform is central to our plan as well According to the Heritage Foundation, by 2030, President Obama's energy restrictions will eliminate another half a million manufacturing jobs, reduce economic output by $2.5 trillion dollars, and reduce incomes by $7,000 dollars per person.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton wants to go even further, and her plan could cost the economy $5 trillion dollars.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: A Trump Administration will lift restrictions on all sources of American energy production.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: According to the Institute for American Energy Resources this will: increase GDP by more than $100 billion annually add over 500,000 new jobs annually increase annual wages by more than $30 billion over the next 7 years increase federal, state, and local tax revenues by almost $6 trillion over 4 decades increase total economic activity by more than $20 trillion over the next 40 years.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In addition, we will streamline the permitting process for all energy infrastructure projects, including the billions of dollars in projects held up by President Obama – creating countless more jobs in the process.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Finally, comes trade – the foundation for everything America's annual trade deficit with the world is now nearly $800 a billion a year – an enormous drag on growth.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Between World War II and the year 2000, the United States averaged a 3.5% growth rate.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But, after China joined the World Trade Organization, our average growth rate has been reduced to only 2 percent.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Predatory trade practices, product dumping, currency manipulation and intellectual property theft have taken millions of jobs and trillions in wealth from our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is no great secret that many of the special interests funding my opponent's campaign are the same people profiting from these terrible trade deals.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The same so-called experts advising Hillary Clinton are the same people who gave us NAFTA, China's entry into the World Trade Organization, the job-killing trade deal with South Korea, and now the Trans-Pacific Partnership.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The verdict is in.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: All of the special interests that the media race to for comment have been proven wrong about every single deal they've promoted – every lie and every prediction has crashed upon the rocks of reality.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our manufacturing base has crumbled, communities have been hollowed out, wages have declined, and households are making less today than they were in the year 2000.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have proposed a detailed plan to reform our trade policies and bring vast new jobs and wealth to America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This includes the following steps: I'm going to direct the Secretary of Commerce to identify every violation of trade agreements a foreign country is currently using to harm our workers.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will use every tool under American and international law to end these abuses, and I will use our greatest business leaders and finest negotiators – and I know who you are, many of you are in the room.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to start with NAFTA, which is causing so much damage to our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will entirely renegotiate NAFTA into a deal that will either be good for us or will be terminated until a brand new and productive deal can be signed.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are also going to keep America out of the Trans-Pacific Partnership.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Next, I am going to instruct my Treasury Secretary to label China a currency manipulator, and to apply tariffs to any country that devalues its currency to gain an unfair advantage over the United States.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am going to instruct the U.S.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Trade Representative to bring trade cases against China.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: China's unfair subsidy behavior is prohibited by the terms of its entrance to the WTO, and I intend to enforce those rules.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: If China does not stop its illegal activities, including its theft of American trade secrets and intellectual property, I will apply countervailing duties until China ceases and desists.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Just the single action of enforcing intellectual property rules alone would add millions of new American jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: According to the U.S.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: International Trade Commission, improved protection of America's intellectual property in China would add 2 million jobs a year to the United States every single year.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to stop the outflow of jobs from our country, and open a new highway of jobs back into our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here is how the plan adds up We are proposing a $4.4 trillion tax cut that will score as $2.6 trillion under a dynamic growth model, which is how taxes should be scored.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This includes the childcare plan.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our economic team has further modeled that the growth-induced savings from trade, energy and regulation reform will shave at least another $1.8 trillion off of the remaining cost.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That leaves around $800 billion dollars.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This money can all be saved through simple, common sense reforms.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: If we save just one penny of each federal dollar spent on non-defense, and non-entitlement programs, we can save almost $1 trillion over the next decade – again this is spending that does not touch defense, and that does not touch entitlements.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: If our plan exceeds the 3.5% ten-year growth average, then our jobs proposal will actually reduce the deficit.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Savings will be compounded by the fact that people who are currently receiving unemployment or welfare will finally be able to find jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is the most pro-growth, pro-jobs, pro-family plan put forth perhaps in the history of our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is what our new future will look like I am going to lower you taxes; I am going to get rid of massive amounts of unnecessary regulations, on business and in your life; I'm going to unleash American energy; I'm going to repeal and replace Obamacare; I'm going to appoint Justices to the Supreme Court who will follow the Constitution; I'm going rebuild our depleted military and take care of our vets; I'm going to save your 2nd amendment; I'm going to stop illegal immigration and drugs coming into our country, and yes, we will build the wall [Mexico will pay]; and I'm going to renegotiate our disastrous trade deals, especially NAFTA – and we will only make great trade deals that put the American worker first.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And we are going to put our miners and our steelworkers back to work.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: American hands will rebuild this nation – and American energy, harvested from American sources, will power this nation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is so great to be in my second home, Florida, and in the city of Miami where I have so many wonderful friends and employees.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: New polls have just come in, and we're leading in battleground states all over this country – including four points here in Florida.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: LA Times has us up 6 points nationwide.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Come November 8th, we are going to win Florida and we are going to win the White House.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's going to be a victory for the people – it's going to be a victory for the workers, the families, the Veterans, the everyday citizens.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And it's going to be a victory for those who haven't had reason for hope in a long time.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I'm campaigning in every community, and every part of this country, for every last vote.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am running to be a President for all Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I just had the most amazing afternoon in Little Haiti and I'm going to be campaigning hard for their votes.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our support comes from all regions, all backgrounds and all walks of life.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: You are cops and soldiers, carpenters and welders, accountants and lawyers, young and old, rich and poor, black, white and Hispanic – but above all else, you are American.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Just today, I was honored to get the endorsement of recipients of the Medal of Honor and many of our amazing military leaders.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We now have the endorsements of more than 160 top generals and Admirals.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We also have the support of 16,500 Border Patrol Officers – as well as law enforcement officers across the country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And we have the support of millions of patriotic Moms and Dads who go to work every day and make this country run.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: While my opponent slanders you as deplorable and irredeemable, I call you hardworking American patriots who love your family and love your country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Clinton's campaign relies on the tired tactic of smearing opponents who question her policies as racists.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's the oldest play in the Democratic play book – and Americans have had enough.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They want solutions, and they want better lives – not more petty attacks from failed and discredited politicians.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Yet, while she lives behind gates and walls and guards, and raises millions from hedge fund managers and Wall Street donors, she slanders and smears working people who just want a fraction of the security enjoyed by our politicians.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Her comments displayed the same sense of arrogance and entitlement that led her to violate federal law as Secretary of State, hide and delete her emails, destroy her phones with a hammer, put classified information in the reach of our enemies, lie to Congress, and sell government favors and access through the Clinton Foundation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's the same attitude of arrogance and entitlement that explains why she has never taken accountability for the disasters she created in Libya, Syria, Iraq, Iran and all over the world.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's the same reason why she won't take responsibility for her central role in unleashing ISIS.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Her policies have created disaster overseas, and poverty at home.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am running to reverse these failures, and create a New American future.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That future begins with prosperity at home.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: One of my highest priorities is to bring jobs into our inner cities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: African-Americans communities have suffered horribly as a result of failed Democratic leadership.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Democrats have run these inner cities for half a century.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They control the mayors' offices, the school boards, the city councils, and the seats in Congress – and all they have delivered is more poverty, more crime, and more failing schools.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: 45% of African-American children under the age of 6 now live in poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: More than 3,000 have been shot in Chicago this year alone.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: These are the results of the policies embraced by Hillary Clinton, and everyone knows that if she's elected the inner cities will get nothing but more pain and more suffering.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton has been there in Washington for 30 years – her disastrous record speaks for itself.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The only people she delivers for is her donors.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am going to deliver for you, the American people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My first day in office, I am going to order a review of every single regulation issued over the last eight years.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to lift the restrictions on American energy – which means at least another half a million new jobs a year.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am also going to completely reform our trade deals.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to renegotiate NAFTA, stand up to China, and keep America out of the TPP.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We don't need another massive multinational deal that ties us up and binds us down.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Since President Obama came into office, another 2 million Hispanic-Americans have fallen into poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To the Hispanic community I say: we are going to protect your jobs, we are going to build up your schools, and we are going to deliver safety and opportunity for your children.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Earlier this week, I also rolled out a plan to help our mothers and our families get affordable, quality childcare for their children.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are also going to stand with the Cuban people in their fight against communist oppression.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The President's one-sided deal for Cuba benefits only the Castro Regime.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But all of the concessions that Barack Obama has granted the Castro Regime were done through executive order, which means the next President can reverse them – and that is what I will do, unless the Castro Regime meets our demands.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Those demands will include religious and political freedom for the Cuban people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Let's also talk about Venezuela.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Venezuela is a beautiful, vibrant, and resource-rich country, filled with amazing and hardworking people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But Venezuela has been run into the ground by socialists.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The next President of the United States must stand in solidarity with all people oppressed in our hemisphere, and I will stand with the oppressed people of Venezuela yearning to be free.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here, in America, I will push to expand freedom for all of our people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am going to lower you taxes; I am going to get rid of massive amounts of unnecessary regulations, on business and in your life; I'm going to repeal and replace Obamacare; I'm going to appoint Justices to the Supreme Court who will follow the Constitution; I'm going to rebuild our depleted military and take care of our vets; I'm going to save your 2nd amendment; I'm going to stop illegal immigration and drugs coming into our country, and yes, we will build the wall and I'm going to renegotiate our disastrous trade deals, especially NAFTA – and we will make great trade deals that put the American worker first.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Thanks, Maria, for that introduction, and for the work you and your organization do to honor these stolen American lives – and to advocate for justice on behalf of all American victims.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am honored to be here today and to shine a national spotlight on a group of victims who have been forced into the shadows.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Your stories are not featured in the news, you have no demonstrators taking to the streets on your behalf, you have no special interests taking up your cause, and politicians ignore your cries for help.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But I never will.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have met many incredible people during the course of this campaign.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But nothing has moved me more deeply than the time I've spent with the families of the Remembrance Project, and the incredible strength and courage you've shown in your often lonely fight for justice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And your actions will help us to save the next thousand American citizens from losing their brothers, sisters, sons, daughters or parents.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The most fundamental duty of government is to protect American lives.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Anyone who fails to understand this is not fit to hold public office.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every day our border remains open, innocent Americans are needlessly victimized.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every day Sanctuary Cities are left in place, innocent Americans are put in harm's way.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every day we fail to enforce our laws is a day when a loving parent is at risk of losing their child.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's happening every single day.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: All across this country, dining room tables have an empty seat at the family dinner table, because our government abandoned its duty and failed to enforce the laws.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: There are a lot of numbers in the immigration debate.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But let me give you the most important number of all.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That most important number of all is the number of American lives it is acceptable to lose in the name of illegal immigration.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Let me tell you what that number is: ZERO.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our nation should not accept one lost American life because our country failed to enforce its laws.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: What do you tell to the mother, who just buried her daughter, because someone was released at the border who should have been sent home?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: What do you tell to the young boy, who will grow up without a dad, because a criminal was deported five times but was allowed to keep coming back into the country?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: What do you tell the wife, who has lost her husband, because a Sanctuary City released an illegal immigrant from behind bars?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And it must end right now.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Not one more American life should be given up in the name of open borders.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Just look at what's happened in the last few days.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Last week it was reported that authorities detained an illegal immigrant in the Austin area who is responsible for nearly a dozen sexual assaults and had been previously deported five times within a three-year period.
