text: I also want to thank the Marcellus Shale Coalition, the Ohio Oil and Gas Association, and the West Virginia Oil and Natural Gas Association for inviting me to join you here today.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Your organizations represent tens of thousands of jobs for hardworking Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Let me also recognize my friend, Harold Hamm.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is great to be here in Pittsburgh, the Steel City.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Under a Trump Administration, we are going to bring back our steel jobs and we are going to rebuild this nation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Before going any further today, I want to address the turmoil unfolding right now in our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our country desperately needs unity, and it needs the spirit of togetherness that has not only got us through our toughest times – but which has lifted us up, in the past, to our greatest achievements as a nation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every day, I see people of different backgrounds working together for a common good, and we need to bring that spirit to every part of our country – and become One American Nation, united by our shared values and principles as American Citizens.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We all have to walk a mile in someone else's shoes, see things through their eyes, and then get to work fixing our wounded country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Many Americans are watching the unrest in Charlotte unfolding on their TV screens.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Others are witnessing the chaos and the violence firsthand.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our country looks bad to the world, especially when we are supposed to be the leader.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: How can we lead when we can't even control our own cities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We honor and recognize the right of all Americans to peacefully assemble, protest and demonstrate.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But there is no right to engage in violent disruption, or to threaten the public safety and peace.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every single American in this country is entitled to live in a safe community.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The violence against our citizens, and our law enforcement, must be brought to an end.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The people who will suffer the most as a result of these riots, are law-abiding African-American residents who live in these communities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is their jobs, housing markets, schools and economic conditions that will suffer – and the first duty of government is to protect their well-being and safety.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our job is not to make life more comfortable for the violent disruptor, but to make life more comfortable for the African-American parent trying to raise their kids in peace.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: For every one violent protestor, there are thousands of moms and dads and kids in that same community who just want to be able to sleep safely at night.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Last year, we saw a 17% rise in violent crime in our fifty largest cities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: More than 3,000 have been shot in Chicago so far this year alone.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Nationwide, approximately 60% of murder victims under the age of 22 are African-American.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is a national crisis, and it is the job of the next President to work with our governors and mayors to address this crisis and save African-American lives.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Look at the example of Mayor Rudy Giuliani in New York.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The policies he put into place ultimately brought down crime by 76 percent and murder by 84 percent.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Think of how many families these policies saved from the worst heartache imaginable.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We need a national anti-crime agenda to make our cities safe again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will appoint the best prosecutors, investigators and federal law enforcement officers in the country to dismantle the international cartels, gangs and criminal syndicates – and I will stop the drugs from flowing into our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My Administration will work with local communities and local officials to make the reduction of crime a top priority.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Safety is the foundation of the ladder to American success: a great education, and a good-paying job.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To have the best schools, and the best jobs, you must have safe communities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That means we must recognize the contributions of our police, who come from all backgrounds and all walks of life, and who often thanklessly risk their own lives to protect the innocent.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We all remember, earlier this year, when officers in Dallas – hunted down for execution – continued protecting the public until their last moments on earth.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every day, police officers risk their lives for complete strangers and, every year, many of them will go out on calls and never return.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They are the line separating civilization from total chaos.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They are also the front lines of defense in the War on Terror, as we saw recently with their quick action following the terrorist attacks in New Jersey, and New York, and the off-duty police officer's heroic actions in Minnesota.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In addition to providing safety, we must provide economic opportunity.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That begins with school choice, and leads to a secure job with a rising income.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This brings us to the subject of energy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Producing more American energy is a central part of my plan to Making America Wealthy Again – especially for the poorest Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: America is sitting on a treasure trove of untapped energy – some $50 trillion dollars in shale energy, oil reserves and natural gas on federal lands, in addition to hundreds of years of coal energy reserves.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's all upside: more jobs, more revenues, more wealth, higher wages, and lower energy prices.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am going to lift the restrictions on American energy, and allow this wealth to pour into our communities – including right here in Pennsylvania.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: According to the Institute for Energy Research, lifting the restrictions on American energy, including shale production, will accomplish the following: increase GDP by more than $100 billion annually add over 500,000 new jobs annually increase annual wages by more than $30 billion over the next 7 years increase federal, state, and local tax revenues by almost $6 trillion over 4 decades increase total economic activity by more than $20 trillion over the next 40 years.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Overall, my entire economic plan – tax reform, regulatory reform, energy reform, and trade reform – will create at least 25 million new jobs over the next 10 years, assuming an average growth rate of 3.5 percent, and I believe we will reach 4% growth.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My tax plan includes a fifteen percent business tax rate, for small and large businesses, down from 35 percent today – turning America into a jobs magnet.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton would raise taxes on some small businesses to as high as 45 percent.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Income taxes will be simplified from 7 brackets to 3, and middle class Americans will get a major tax cut – including childcare deductions and tax-free childcare savings accounts.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My plan includes the elimination of all unnecessary regulations, and a temporary moratorium on new regulations not compelled by Congress or public safety.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Overregulation is costing our economy $2 trillion a year.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On energy, my economic plan unlocks our shale oil and gas, and the energy technologies of both today and tomorrow.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Finally, my plan includes a renegotiation of America's trade deals, and the enforcement of trade rules, to increase jobs and wealth inside the United States.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Strong border controls will also protect our workers and save our budget trillions in the long-term.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is perhaps the most pro-growth economic plan in American history.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Compare that to my opponent.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She plans a $1.3 trillion tax hike, massive new regulations, the offshoring of American jobs, and the aggressive restriction of American energy production.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Her plan will help only her wealthy donors, and global special interests, who benefit from the rigged system.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton wants to put the coal miners out of work, ban hydraulic fracturing in most places, and extensively restrict and ban energy production on public lands and in most offshore areas.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This will produce devastation for states like Pennsylvania, Ohio, and West Virginia, where shale energy and coal production are critical parts of the economy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Her plan hurts states like Colorado, Florida, Virginia, North Carolina, and any anywhere with access to either onshore or offshore energy resources.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She also supports blocking the energy infrastructure that is needed to move our energy resources to the marketplace.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: According to the Wall Street Journal, Overall, more than a dozen [fossil fuel] projects, worth about $33 billion, have been either rejected by regulators or withdrawn by developers since 2012, with billions more tied up in projects still in regulatory limbo.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Examples of energy transportation projects blocked or abandoned include an $850 million coal export facility in Washington, a $3 billion natural gas pipeline in the Northeast, and a $6.8 billion Liquid Natural Gas export facility, among others.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Billions of dollars in private infrastructure investment have been lost to the Obama-Clinton restriction agenda.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The platform produced by Hillary Clinton's party this year also calls for a price on carbon.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That's just political-speak for a massive new tax on coal and shale production – a tax on American consumers.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And remember, every energy dollar that isn't harvested here in America is harvested instead in a foreign country – often foreign countries not very friendly to us.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That not only means we are sending our jobs to those countries, but it means energy is being produced in foreign countries that lack our high environmental and conservation standards.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That is just one more reason why we should pursue the safe and responsible production of America's vast energy reserves.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We need an America-First energy plan.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This means opening federal lands for oil and gas production; opening offshore areas; and revoking policies that are imposing unnecessary restrictions on innovative new exploration technologies.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The development of the Marcellus and Utica Shales will fundamentally change the economic landscape of this region and our country, bringing extraordinary new prosperity to millions – more jobs, higher wages, a larger tax base, and dollars flowing into our country for a change, instead of out of our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton's war on energy will cost our economy $5 trillion dollars.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: She has not only declared war on the miners but on oil and natural gas production – which supports 10 million jobs in the United States.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Access to low-cost liquid natural gas also supports the American chemical industry, which supports 40,000 jobs in Pennsylvania.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We have just begun, as a nation, to recognize our economic advantage that is made possible by shale energy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Shale Energy Revolution will unleash massive wealth for American workers and families.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: At the same time, this energy revolution will produce new demand for American steel.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But federal restrictions remain a major impediment to both shale production specifically, and energy production in general.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Currently, less than 10 percent of the federally managed surface and mineral estates are leased for oil and gas development.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Almost 90% of our nation's offshore acreage is off-limits to energy production.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our energy policy will make full use of our domestic energy sources, including traditional and renewable energy sources.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That means we will end the war on coal.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will rescind the coal mining lease moratorium, the excessive Interior Department stream rule, and conduct a top-down review of all anti-coal regulations issued by the Obama Administration.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will eliminate the highly-invasive Waters of the US rule, and scrap the $5 trillion dollar Obama-Clinton Climate Action Plan and the Clean Power Plan – these unilateral plans will increase monthly electric bills by double-digits without any measurable improvement in climate.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will refocus the EPA on its core mission of ensuring clean air, and clean, safe drinking water for all Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I believe firmly in conserving our wonderful natural resources and beautiful natural habitats.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My environmental agenda will be guided by true specialists in conservation, not those with radical political agendas.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It will be a future of conservation, of prosperity, and of great success.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It will be a future of new technology, new innovation, and new solutions.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It will be a future we can achieve together, beginning with a victory on November 8th.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's wonderful to be here in Virginia, a state where I have so many great friends and wonderful employees.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Tremendous polls keep coming in.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: A brand new Rasmussen poll has us up 5 points nationwide.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: On November 8th, we are going to win this state and we are going to win the White House.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to take on the big donors, and big business, and big media – we are going to take on the rigged system that has shipped America's wealth to other countries.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to replace our failed and corrupt establishment with a new government that serves you, your family, and your country.

text: We will cut taxes for all working and middle-class households in America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will reduce regulations, which will put more money into the hands of our workers and bring thousands of new companies to our shores.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will unleash American energy, creating millions of new jobs and lowering energy costs.

text: The Obama-Clinton energy restrictions are nothing more than a massive tax on the poor – we will remove those restrictions day one.

text: On trade, we are going to end the international abuse, the foreign cheating, and the one-sided rules that govern NAFTA and the World Trade Organization.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our massive, chronic trade deficits are destroying the middle class – and shifting money away from workers to large corporations who have no borders.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton is the voice for the global special interests.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am running to be the voice of the forgotten men and women.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And just last week, joined by my daughter, Ivanka, I laid out my plan for childcare and eldercare.

text: That plan has many great features, including tax-free childcare savings accounts.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Low-income parents are given tax credits they can put straight into those accounts, and then get a $500 dollar per child match for those savings accounts deposits.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Families can also deduct the cost of childcare from their taxes, a huge tax cut for the middle class.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We have also talked about improving education.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My plan includes school choice for every disadvantaged child in America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are also going to bring down the cost of college.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Universities get massive federal funds, and huge tax breaks for their endowments – but then they don't spend those funds or those endowments on their students.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will work with Congress to make sure these special federal benefits are not available unless universities begin to reduce tuition and student debt.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This will get to the problem at the source, and reduce both the cost for students and the cost for taxpayers.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our students are drowning and we're going to fix it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They want a Commander-in-Chief that will defeat radical Islamic terrorism, stop the massive inflow of refugees, protect our borders, and who will reduce the rising crime and violence in our cities.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here, in Virginia, we are going to end the war on American energy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton says she wants to put the miners out of work.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Clinton and Kaine also want to shut down shale, and shut down natural gas.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Clinton regulatory agenda will drive up electricity prices for Virginia families and will cost the U.S. economy over $5 trillion.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: By the way, less than a week after taking office, Tim Kaine proposed a $4 billion dollar tax hike in Virginia, including on people earning as little as $17,000 dollars a year.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to open up all sources of American energy and bring jobs, wealth, and cheaper electricity to Virginia.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Another major part of our agenda is safety.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I believe every family in America is entitled to live in safety and peace.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Today, the nation just opened the Smithsonian National Museum of African-American History and Culture.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We congratulate and honor those involved with the project, and recognize today the incredible contributions of the African-American community to this nation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: African-Americans have given so much to this nation and sacrificed so much for this nation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Many African-Americans are succeeding so greatly in our country, and I will make sure their success is protected and supported.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: At the same time, too many African-Americans have been left behind and trapped in poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will fight to make sure every single African-American child in this country is fully included in the American Dream.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That includes the new civil rights issue of our time: School Choice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Democrats have run the inner cities for half a century or more, and produced only more joblessness and poverty.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The jobs are leaving, the schools are failing, and crime is rising.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To those suffering, I say: Vote for Donald Trump.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will fight harder for you than anyone has before.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The policies of Hillary Clinton have brought only suffering in our inner cities – just like her bad judgment overseas unleashed suffering everywhere she went.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Of course, she got rich through it all – the Clintons made another $60 million in gross income while she was Secretary of State.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Worst of all, she put her public office up for sale – and then bleached her emails, and destroyed her phones, to try to cover her tracks following a congressional subpoena.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: There's a reason the hedge fund managers are donating to Hillary Clinton's campaign – and not mine.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every dollar helps us deliver your country back to you.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our campaign is about breaking up the special interest monopoly in Washington, D.C.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It used to be the cars were made in Flint, and you couldn't drink the water in Mexico.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Today, cars are made in Mexico, and you can't drink the water in Flint.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We'll turn it all around.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: You have 44 days until the big vote.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: You have 44 days to make possible every dream you ever dreamed of for your country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: You have one magnificent chance to deliver justice for every forgotten man, woman, and child in this nation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Here is just some of what will happen starting in January of 2017: I am going to lower your taxes; eliminate every unnecessary regulation; unleash American energy; end illegal immigration – and yes we will build the wall [Mexico will pay]; save the 2nd amendment, and appoint Justices to the Supreme Court who will uphold and defend the Constitution of the United States.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will rebuild our roads, bridges, tunnels, highways, airports, schools, and hospitals.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And we will put our great miners and steelworkers back to work.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is time to break with the bitter failures of the past and to embrace a new, inclusive and prosperous American future.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton has a 3-word campaign pledge.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It reads: I'm With Her.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I have a different pledge: I'm With You – the American People.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To all of our people, in all of our cities and towns, I say these words to you tonight: I'm with you, I will fight for you, and I will win for you.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's so great to be in Wisconsin tonight.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: A recent Reuters poll had us tied in Wisconsin, and we were just in Iowa where we are up by 10 in the Reuters poll – and a new post-debate Google poll has leading Hillary Clinton by 2 points nationwide, and that's despite the fact that they were suppressing bad news about Hillary Clinton.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's going to be a victory for you, the American people.

text: We are going to end the Clinton Corruption and restore dignity and honesty to government service.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Hillary Clinton is an insider who fights only for her donors and for herself.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I am an outsider fighting for you.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: One of the first things we are going to do is restore law and order to this country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our good friend, Sheriff Clarke, is here with us tonight.

text: Homicides are up nearly 50% in Washington D.C. and more than 60% in Baltimore.

text: Across the entire nation, for cities of all sizes, small and large, the homicide rates rose by more than 10% last year.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is a national crisis.

text: For those who have chosen not to support me in the past, of which there were a few people, I'm reaching out to you for your guidance and your help so that we can work together and unify our great country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: As I've said from the beginning, ours was not a campaign but rather an incredible and great movement, made up of millions of hard-working men and women who love their country and want a better, brighter future for themselves and for their family.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is a movement comprised of Americans from all races, religions, backgrounds, and beliefs, who want and expect our government to serve the people -- and serve the people it will.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Working together, we will begin the urgent task of rebuilding our nation and renewing the American dream.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I've spent my entire life in business, looking at the untapped potential in projects and in people all over the world.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That is now what I want to do for our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I've gotten to know our country so well.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is going to be a beautiful thing.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every single American will have the opportunity to realize his or her fullest potential.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The forgotten men and women of our country will be forgotten no longer.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are going to fix our inner cities and rebuild our highways, bridges, tunnels, airports, schools, hospitals.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We're going to rebuild our infrastructure, which will become, by the way, second to none.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And we will put millions of our people to work as we rebuild it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will also finally take care of our great veterans who have been so loyal, and I've gotten to know so many over this 18-month journey.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The time I've spent with them during this campaign has been among my greatest honors.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our veterans are incredible people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will embark upon a project of national growth and renewal.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will harness the creative talents of our people, and we will call upon the best and brightest to leverage their tremendous talent for the benefit of all.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is going to happen.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We have a great economic plan.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will double our growth and have the strongest economy anywhere in the world.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: At the same time, we will get along with all other nations willing to get along with us.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will have great relationships.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We expect to have great, great relationships.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: No dream is too big, no challenge is too great.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Nothing we want for our future is beyond our reach.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: America will no longer settle for anything less than the best.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We must reclaim our country's destiny and dream big and bold and daring.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We're going to dream of things for our country, and beautiful things and successful things once again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I want to tell the world community that while we will always put America's interests first, we will deal fairly with everyone, with everyone.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: All people and all other nations.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will seek common ground, not hostility;

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And now I would like to take this moment to thank some of the people who really helped me with this, what they are calling tonight a very, very historic victory.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: First, I want to thank my parents, who I know are looking down on me right now.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I've learned so much from them.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They were wonderful in every regard.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I also want to thank my sisters, Marianne and Elizabeth, who are here with us tonight.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They're very shy, actually.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And my brother Robert, my great friend.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: My brother Robert, and they should be on this stage, but that's okay.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And also my late brother Fred, great guy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I was very lucky.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Great brothers, sisters, great, unbelievable parents.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: To Melania and Don and Ivanka and Eric and Tiffany and Barron, I love you and I thank you, and especially for putting up with all of those hours.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This political stuff is nasty, and it is tough.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: So I want to thank my family very much.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: What a great group.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: You've all given me such incredible support, and I will tell you that we have a large group of people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: You know, they kept saying we have a small staff.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Look at all of the people that we have.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Look at all of these people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And Kellyanne and Chris and Rudy and Steve and David.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We have got tremendously talented people up here, and I want to tell you it's been very, very special.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I want to give a very special thanks to our former mayor, Rudy Giuliani.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: He traveled with us and he went through meetings, and Rudy never changes.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Chris Christie, folks, was unbelievable.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The first man, first senator, first major, major politician.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Let me tell you, he is highly respected in Washington because he is as smart as you get.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Another great man, very tough competitor.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: He was not easy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Is that the mayor that showed up?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Really a friend to me, but I'll tell you, I got to know him as a competitor because he was one of the folks that was negotiating to go against those Democrats, Dr.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: By the way, Mike Huckabee is here someplace, and he is fantastic.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Mike and his family Sarah, thank you very much.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We have over 200 generals and admirals that have endorsed our campaign and they are special people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We have 22 Congressional Medal of Honor people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: A very special person who, believe me, I read reports that I wasn't getting along with him.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I never had a bad second with him.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: He's an unbelievable star.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: that's right, how did you possibly guess?

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Let me tell you about Reince.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Look at all of those people over there.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I know it, Reince is a superstar.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I said, they can't call you a superstar, Reince, unless we win it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: He would not have that bust at the track at Belmont.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Reince is really a star and he is the hardest-working guy, and in a certain way I did this.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Reince, come up here.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Get over here, Reince.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Boy, oh, boy, oh, boy.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's about time you did this right.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our partnership with the RNC was so important to the success and what we've done, so I also have to say, I've gotten to know some incredible people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Secret Service people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They're tough and they're smart and they're sharp and I don't want to mess around with them, I can tell you.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And when I want to go and wave to a big group of people and they rip me down and put me back down in the seat, but they are fantastic people so I want to thank the Secret Service.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And law enforcement in New York City, they're here tonight.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: These are spectacular people, sometimes underappreciated unfortunately.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: So it's been what they call a historic event, but to be really historic, we have to do a great job, and I promise you that I will not let you down.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will do a great job.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I look very much forward to being your president, and hopefully at the end of two years or three years or four years or maybe even eight years you will say so many of you worked so hard for us, with you.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: You will say that -- you will say that that was something that you were -- really were very proud to do and I can — thank you very much.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And I can only say that while the campaign is over, our work on this movement is now really just beginning.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We're going to get to work immediately for the American people, and we're going to be doing a job that hopefully you will be so proud of your President.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Again, it's my honor.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's an amazing evening.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It's been an amazing two-year period, and I love this country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Thank you to Mike Pence.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Chief Justice Roberts, President Carter, President Clinton, President Bush, President Obama, fellow Americans, and people of the world: Thank you.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We, the citizens of America, are now joined in a great national effort to rebuild our country and to restore its promise for all of our people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Together, we will determine the course of America and the world for years to come.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will face challenges.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will confront hardships.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But we will get the job done.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every four years, we gather on these steps to carry out the orderly and peaceful transfer of power, and we are grateful to President Obama and First Lady Michelle Obama for their gracious aid throughout this transition.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: They have been magnificent.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Today's ceremony, however, has very special meaning.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Because today we are not merely transferring power from one administration to another, or from one party to another -- but we are transferring power from Washington, D.C. and giving it back to you, the American People.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: For too long, a small group in our nation's Capital has reaped the rewards of government while the people have borne the cost.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Washington flourished -- but the people did not share in its wealth.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Politicians prospered -- but the jobs left, and the factories closed.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The establishment protected itself, but not the citizens of our country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Their victories have not been your victories;

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Their triumphs have not been your triumphs;

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And while they celebrated in our nation's capital, there was little to celebrate for struggling families all across our land.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: That all changes -- starting right here, and right now, because this moment is your moment: it belongs to you.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It belongs to everyone gathered here today and everyone watching all across America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is your day.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This is your celebration.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And this, the United States of America, is your country.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: What truly matters is not which party controls our government, but whether our government is controlled by the people.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: January 20th 2017, will be remembered as the day the people became the rulers of this nation again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Everyone is listening to you now.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: You came by the tens of millions to become part of a historic movement the likes of which the world has never seen before.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: At the center of this movement is a crucial conviction: that a nation exists to serve its citizens.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Americans want great schools for their children, safe neighborhoods for their families, and good jobs for themselves.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: These are the just and reasonable demands of a righteous public.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But for too many of our citizens, a different reality exists: Mothers and children trapped in poverty in our inner cities;

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Rusted-out factories scattered like tombstones across the landscape of our nation;

speaker: Donald Trump
text: An education system flush with cash, but which leaves our young and beautiful students deprived of knowledge;

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And the crime and gangs and drugs that have stolen too many lives and robbed our country of so much unrealized potential.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: This American carnage stops right here and stops right now.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We are one nation -- and their pain is our pain.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Their dreams are our dreams;

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And their success will be our success.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We share one heart, one home, and one glorious destiny.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The oath of office I take today is an oath of allegiance to all Americans.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: For many decades, we've enriched foreign industry at the expense of American industry;

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Subsidized the armies of other countries while allowing for the very sad depletion of our military;

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We've defended other nation's borders while refusing to defend our own;

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And spent trillions of dollars overseas while America's infrastructure has fallen into disrepair and decay.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We've made other countries rich while the wealth, strength, and confidence of our country has disappeared over the horizon.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: One by one, the factories shuttered and left our shores, with not even a thought about the millions upon millions of American workers left behind.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The wealth of our middle class has been ripped from their homes and then redistributed across the entire world.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: But that is the past.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And now we are looking only to the future.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We assembled here today are issuing a new decree to be heard in every city, in every foreign capital, and in every hall of power.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: From this day forward, a new vision will govern our land.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: From this moment on, it's going to be America First.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Every decision on trade, on taxes, on immigration, on foreign affairs, will be made to benefit American workers and American families.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We must protect our borders from the ravages of other countries making our products, stealing our companies, and destroying our jobs.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Protection will lead to great prosperity and strength.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: I will fight for you with every breath in my body -- and I will never, ever let you down.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: America will start winning again, winning like never before.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will bring back our borders.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will bring back our wealth.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And we will bring back our dreams.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will build new roads, and highways, and bridges, and airports, and tunnels, and railways all across our wonderful nation.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will get our people off of welfare and back to work -- rebuilding our country with American hands and American labor.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will follow two simple rules: Buy American and hire American.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will seek friendship and goodwill with the nations of the world -- but we do so with the understanding that it is the right of all nations to put their own interests first.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We do not seek to impose our way of life on anyone, but rather to let it shine as an example for everyone to follow.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will reinforce old alliances and form new ones -- and unite the civilized world against radical Islamic terrorism, which we will eradicate completely from the face of the Earth.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: At the bedrock of our politics will be a total allegiance to the United States of America, and through our loyalty to our country, we will rediscover our loyalty to each other.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: When you open your heart to patriotism, there is no room for prejudice.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The Bible tells us, How good and pleasant it is when God's people live together in unity.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We must speak our minds openly, debate our disagreements honestly, but always pursue solidarity.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: When America is united, America is totally unstoppable.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: There should be no fear -- we are protected, and we will always be protected.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will be protected by the great men and women of our military and law enforcement and, most importantly, we are protected by God.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Finally, we must think big and dream even bigger.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: In America, we understand that a nation is only living as long as it is striving.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will no longer accept politicians who are all talk and no action -- constantly complaining but never doing anything about it.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: The time for empty talk is over.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Now arrives the hour of action.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Do not let anyone tell you it cannot be done.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: No challenge can match the heart and fight and spirit of America.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will not fail.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Our country will thrive and prosper again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We stand at the birth of a new millennium, ready to unlock the mysteries of space, to free the Earth from the miseries of disease, and to harness the energies, industries and technologies of tomorrow.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: A new national pride will stir our souls, lift our sights, and heal our divisions.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: It is time to remember that old wisdom our soldiers will never forget: that whether we are black or brown or white, we all bleed the same red blood of patriots, we all enjoy the same glorious freedoms, and we all salute the same great American Flag.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And whether a child is born in the urban sprawl of Detroit or the windswept plains of Nebraska, they look up at the same night sky, they fill their heart with the same dreams, and they are infused with the breath of life by the same almighty Creator.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: So to all Americans, in every city near and far, small and large, from mountain to mountain, and from ocean to ocean, hear these words: You will never be ignored again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Your voice, your hopes, and your dreams will define our American destiny.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And your courage and goodness and love will forever guide us along the way.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: Together, We will make America strong again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: We will make wealthy again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And yes, together, we will make America great again.

speaker: Donald Trump
text: And God bless America.
